🚀 WHY JOIN CARE OPS IN 2026? 🚀

You might look at Alan’s Care team today—managing high volumes seamlessly, supported by strong partners, and automating 40% of conversations—and ask: "It works, so why join now?"

Yet, the most exciting part is still ahead. We are at a turning point as we prepare to support millions of members and push to set the standards in the industry.

Here is why this is the moment to join.

 - People: This is the opportunity to join a team with incredibly high talent density, operating with distributed ownership—empowered Crew Leads, strong deputies, and Guillaume Poirier https://www.linkedin.com/in/guillaume-p-34602923/ as Care Ops Lead. It is a proven engine for creating talent and fueling internal mobility.

 - Processes: We absorb high volumes without glitches (including Ministry of Finance in France) and collaborate smoothly with Product and Sales. We trust and work hand-in-hand with solid external partners in France and Spain.

 - Innovation: We are one of the few companies in the world claiming to automate 40% of member conversations as of end of 2025 (a true market benchmark).




We are pushing to create an organization capable of absorbing 3 million members with a lean team of Care Experts. To do this, we need to solve problems no one else has solved:

 - AI & Quality at Scale: We haven't yet fully engaged our partners to deliver high-quality, AI-powered service at scale.

 - Productivity: We are still resource-intensive. We know AI is the lever to crack the productivity of both our internal experts and external agents, and we are testing it—but we need to master it.

 - The Automation Glass Ceiling: We have hit 40%, but we need to break through to the next level.

Recognition: We are building something unique, yet we are not yet known externally as the reference for Care operations.




⭐ THE CARE OPS ROLE ⭐

The Care Ops team supports the Care Community globally (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) by providing tools, processes, and data to deliver on our Roadmap and Strategic Plan. Care Ops is accountable for operational excellence and efficiency in Care, enabling the Community to scale without any compromise on user experience.

Care Ops collaborates closely with Care, Ops, Data, Engineers, and Product teams. Within a team of 8, we are seeking a Care Ops to take ownership of care tooling and efficiency:

Some of our missions include:



1/ Efficiency and performance monitoring

 - Conduct deep dives into performance monitoring (SLAs, ticket-level framework, etc.) and share actionable findings to support the decision-making process.

 - Identify areas where processes don't scale, prioritize them, and introduce solutions that include automation, externalization, or the implementation of AI-driven use cases.

 - Push and prioritize efficiency needs to the Product crews.

2/ Contact experience

 - Pilot the launch of new contact channel projects, such as a direct phone line to help address new customer segments (Large / Very Large Deals) and digitally challenged members.

 - Support the globalization of Alan's contacting experience and anticipate the impacts for the Care Community

3/ Tooling:

 - Identify and prioritize areas where current processes are not scalable, proposing effective tool-powered solutions, including automation and AI-driven use cases.

 - Collaborate with dedicated Product crews to improve the efficiency of our tooling stack.

 - Drive the change by leading the implementation of new processes and pushing for their adoption across relevant parties.

 - Evangelize the use of AI within the Community to foster understanding and encourage its integration into everyday processes.

 - Own our tooling stack (Automation Platform, Intercom, Dust, Klaus, Aircall, etc.) and act as the point of contact for the Care Ops team for tooling needs and projects, ensuring tools are up-to-date, integrated, and comply with our security and legal requirements.

 - Manage business partnerships with external providers and oversee RFP processes.




⭐ JOIN THE CARE TEAM! ⭐️

You will excel as a Care Ops if you:

 - Possess strong written and verbal communication skills in English & French.

 - Have excellent project management and leadership skills to coordinate multiple stakeholders.

 - Are passionate about process optimization and can implement solutions in a quick and iterative way.

 - Have an organized and structured mindset.

 -  Showcase robust data analytics abilities (proficiency in SQL is highly desirable)

 - Can work independently in a fast-paced environment.

 - Demonstrate excellent growth potential.

 - Showcase interest in no-code, AI, and tooling.

Whether you're a recent engineer/business graduate with a passion for AI and no-code or an Ops with 3 -5 years of experience and a knack for managing tools and building integrations, we want to hear from you.

Our ideal candidate thrives in a startup or tech company environment and is excited about the opportunity to make a significant impact in a growing company. If this sounds like you, then you might just be the Care Ops we're looking for.

We value diversity and encourage individuals from varied experiences and backgrounds to apply. Join our Care team and contribute to our mission of delivering an exceptional user experience.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B-C level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.



IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

 - Own the strategy and execution plan for your vertical, aligned with Care’s strategic priorities (quality, member experience, scalability, cost-to-serve).

 - Be accountable for measurable outcomes for your vertical (e.g., member satisfaction, resolution quality, productivity, SLA/backlog health, cost-to-serve).

3) Cross-functional delivery (Product, Data, Engineering)

 - Write crisp problem statements and decision docs, align stakeholders, and drive execution from discovery to rollout.

 - Manage trade-offs between speed, quality, compliance, and cost, and bring the right stakeholders in early.



4) Stakeholder & change leadership

 - Lead the vertical as an “area”: create clarity on mission, roles, priorities, and rituals for contributors involved (Care Ops and Care Specialists).

 - Coach and support team members to grow their scope and impact through feedback, structured problem-solving, and ownership.

 - Influence senior stakeholders with clear narratives, data, and recommendations—internally and, when relevant, externally.



5) Outsourcing / partner management (possible scope)

 - Own partner strategy and governance: expectations, performance management, escalation paths, and continuous improvement plans.

 - Lead vendor selection and transitions when needed (RFPs, comparative analysis, negotiation, ramp-up plans).

 - Manage unit economics for outsourced scopes and drive cost-per-ticket improvements without compromising quality or member experience.

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c on our Engineering career path.




🌐 ENABLING GLOBAL-FIRST PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

In Alan's early expansion https://medium.com/alan/an-unexpected-journey-the-tale-of-the-backend-architecture-at-alan-ac8c5382df60, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024 https://medium.com/alan/engineering-challenges-at-alan-in-2024-686688f6b89d, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy https://medium.com/alan/alans-2025-technical-strategy-building-tomorrow-s-stack-today-a070bcb345a6.



🚀 Your mission

 - Design Cross-Cutting Modules You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features

 - Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business

 - Orchestrate Data Transformations You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas

We’re building Mo — a health companion for everyone.

We’re a small team within Alan, on a mission to redefine the future of care by democratizing access to medical expertise. We are building Mo, an intelligent, empathetic, multimodal LLM-based conversational AI assistant able to prescribe, triage, and proactively follow up on care.

Imagine giving every person in the world instant, 24/7 access to personalised medical expertise - through chat, voice, or video. That’s what we are building 🤖.

We kicked off the project in 2023, and we have launched Mo to all our french members (1M) in Q1 2026, making it the first safe AI health companion live at scale in Europe.

We’re building a medical agent that works — reliably, safely, and at scale.

Alan is scaling internationally (900+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Operations Specialists to own device security, SaaS platforms, identity & access, and the daily IT experience of every Alaner, while contributing to build projects that remove operational toil.

IT at Alan is more than just a helpdesk. Operations and support ('Run') take roughly 60% of your time initially, while the rest goes toward owning project-based initiatives ('Build') tailored to your experience level. 
As you ramp up alongside senior engineers, your focus will naturally shift toward more build-focused work with wider impact.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. We staff people according to their strengths and interests, and it evolves over time.



SCOPE


🛟 SUPPORT & ONCALL

 - Own L1/L2 oncall for 900+ Alaners across 5+ countries, with a clear escalation path to engineers

 - Triage, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately

 - Document recurring issues and reduce ticket volume through self-service


💻 DEVICE LIFECYCLE & ENDPOINT COMPLIANCE

 - Own the full device lifecycle: procurement, zero-touch enrollment (Apple Business Manager, Kandji), repair, retrieval

 - Maintain role-based Kandji blueprints and least-privilege configurations

 - Contribute to device compliance across all countries (MDM, EDR, FileVault) and to audit evidence

 - Own the physical side: laptop locker, hardware inventory, office equipment

 - Take over day-to-day device operations as we bring them back in-house from our outsourced provider


🔑 IDENTITY, ACCESS & SAAS PLATFORMS

 - Own onboarding and offboarding end-to-end, across both automated and manually-managed tools

 - Administer Google Workspace, SSO/SAML, licences and access reviews

 - Manage day-to-day vendor relationships and procurement on your scope


⚙️ BUILD

 - Own a build project end-to-end, with a more experienced engineer to pair with and learn from

 - Examples from the current roadmap: rebuilding the onboarding intake, the meeting room audiovisual equipment and room-booking revamp, the IT playbook for new offices, ISO 27001 / ACPR evidence collection

 - Ship automation and self-service tooling that measurably reduces IT toil


MILESTONES

First 2 months

 - Join IT oncall rotation (helpdesk) with buddy/shadowing support

 - Discover Alan's processes, stack (Kandji, Apple Business Manager), SaaS ecosystem, and identity tools (Google Workspace, SSO, Alan Home)

 - Handle most typical IT operations issues autonomously (equipment, SaaS access, account provisioning)

First 6 months

 - Handle IT oncall shifts autonomously, solving most problems that do not require engineer input

 - Own onboarding/offboarding workflows end-to-end

 - Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

 - Ship a first project

First year

 - Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

 - Contribute on device compliance improvements (MDM, EDR, FileVault) across all countries

 - Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

 - Lead small to medium IT projects end-to-end

3 years

 - Fully autonomous on the User Experience & Platform workstreams

 - Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

 - Mentor newer team members, reduce bus factor through documentation, automation and knowledge sharing


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

 - 1-3 years in IT operations (or strong internship / student association background in a tech environment): device management (MDM, ideally Kandji), SaaS administration, basic identity & access management (Google Workspace, SSO)

 - Operational reflexes: can triage issues, communicate to users during incidents, and escalate appropriately. Has oncall or production support experience

 - Automation & AI appetite: scripting basics (Python, Bash) or low-code, and an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

 - Documentation mindset: writes clear, structured documentation

 - Learning velocity: Picks up new tools and processes quickly.

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

 - Written-First Communication: Clear, effective written communicator who instinctively documents workflows, shares knowledge transparently, and thrives in an asynchronous work culture.

 - Empathetic Problem-Solving: Balanced user-first service mindset with operational pragmatism—delighting colleagues while diagnosing root causes rather than applying band-aid fixes.

 - Autonomous Growth: Self-directed problem solver who takes early project ownership, learns rapidly alongside senior engineers, and actively seeks feedback to level up.

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

 - macOS fluency: comfortable troubleshooting macOS, understands the Apple ecosystem (Apple Business Manager, DEP enrollment)

 - Experience with Kandji specifically

 - Exposure to security compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS), even just awareness

 - SaaS vendor management and/or license administration

 - Interest in automation and coding (even from college/school projects)

 - Experience in a fast-growing, multi-country tech company

Languages: Fluent French & Professional English

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE INFRA CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA

🎯 Mission:

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Infra - is one of its crews. Its mission: operate and evolve the foundations Alan runs on (multi-cloud infrastructure, data platforms, observability, and the operational practices around them) so that product crews ship safely and quickly, members never feel the platform underneath, and the business can expand to new countries without re-inventing how we run.

🔭 Scope:

 1. Cloud foundations & multi-cloud architecture: own and evolve Alan’s cloud footprint, Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform, Terramate), and the architectural decisions enabling international expansion.

 2. Data & application platforms: operate and evolve the foundations product crews build on: PostgreSQL/Aurora, our events pipeline, async workloads, and database migration tooling, without leaking complexity into product code.

 3. Reliability, observability & on-call: own Alan's platform uptime and latency SLOs end-to-end. Evolve our observability stack (Datadog), the incident response process (Incident.io http://Incident.io), and the shared on-call rotation across the area to keep it sustainable as we scale.

 4. Governance & compliance enablement and FinOps: own the cross-cutting concerns no single domain holds, infrastructure cost (FinOps), IAM posture, backup and disaster recovery, exit strategy, with automation and reporting that scales beyond the crew.

 5. AI-augmented infrastructure operations: make AI assistants a first-class citizen for incident investigation, runbook execution, and toil reduction, so engineers spend their time on high-leverage work.

👀 Focus for 2026:

In 2026, we're growing the team significantly to step up impact across four bets:

 - Multi-cloud expansion: revisit our cloud strategy as we go international, and launch new geographies.

 - Decoupling for scale: evolve service architecture to carry Alan 2.0 from 1M members today to 10M.

 - Operational excellence: raise the quality bar end-to-end by overhauling observability, on-call, and cost management practices.

 - AI-augmented infra ops: make AI assistants a first-class part of investigation, troubleshooting, and toil reduction, so engineers spend time where leverage is highest.




⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - 3+ years in Platform engineering, DevOps, Site reliability engineering or equivalent roles.

 - You have strong experience with cloud platforms (especially AWS or GCP).

 - You're comfortable writing code for automation and tooling (e.g. API, internal command line, developer portal) and willing to work in Python/Typescript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).

 - You have touched observability, monitoring, alerting or incident management tools and practices.

 - You are able to design and implement robust infrastructure systems with a focus on reliability and observability.

 - You can maintain our uptime targets while optimizing infrastructure costs.

 - You’ve built and maintained internal or external tooling (e.g. API, web interface, internal command line, configuration as code, etc) for other engineers.


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat infrastructure and platform engineering as product work: engineers & members are your customers, and infrastructure should feel effortless.

 - You’re hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript, Terraform). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast product crews ship features without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and reliable-by-default abstractions that prevent outages and runaway cost at scale.

You will own the compliance posture on your perimeter, proactively manage our exposure, and be the primary interface with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also be a key connector between the compliance function, internal control, and the audit processes Alan conducts - ensuring audit findings are properly digested, remediated, and embedded into how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will play a central role in ensuring our compliance standards travel with us: adapting Group frameworks to local requirements and helping stand up the right compliance foundations in new geographies.

The role sits within the Legal Area in the Corporate Unit, and involves close daily collaboration with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care, and Product teams across all of Alan's markets.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own Alan's Insurance Compliance Posture

 - Define how regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) translate into Alan's operational processes, product design, and tooling

 - Suggest optimal ways to meet regulatory requirements within Alan's products while improving members' experience - from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

 - Proactively identify compliance risks, assess their exposure, and develop mitigating action plans in coordination with internal stakeholders

 - Lead the structuring and continuous improvement of Alan's complaints management framework across France, Belgium, and Spain, ensuring compliance with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

 - Serve as the compliance function's key contributor to Alan's internal control system: document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group's centralised mapping, and co-deploy the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

 - Prepare and support internal and external audits: assess Alan's standing against planned operational improvements, define remediation plans, and drive and monitor their effective implementation

 - Report on compliance obligations and risk exposure to Alan's Board and governance committees, with clarity and foresight; Manage regulatory reporting obligations including the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

 - Respond to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA, or equivalent in Alan’s operating countries), coordinating internally and ensuring Alan is always audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

 - Support the AML framework: conduct second-level analysis on suspicious cases, manage relationships with regulatory bodies and financial intelligence units, approve high-risk client relationships (including PEPs), and maintain the AML/CFT risk assessment framework

 - Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

 - Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

 - Maintain Alan's compliance roadmap: prioritise, track progress, update the risk mapping, and re-prioritise as the regulatory environment evolves

 - Lead compliance projects with internal stakeholders across Insurance, Product, Sales, Care, and Operations, translating regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

 - Contribute to  pragmatic compliance positions on regulatory requirements that affect our products and contracts - turning complex constraints into well-reasoned, pragmatic solutions that support the business.

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

 - Design and maintain mandatory regulatory training programmes for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

 - Build internal compliance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making tools that increase team autonomy and reduce reliance on external resources

 - Contribute to Alan's written culture by producing high-quality documentation that teams can rely on independently

International Compliance & Localisation

 - Ensure Alan's compliance standards travel consistently across all Group markets, whether existing (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) or newly opened, adapting Group frameworks to local regulatory requirements and deploying them locally in coordination with local counsel. 

 


PROFILE

Experience & Skills

 - 4+ years of experience in compliance in an insurance or fintech company; solid coverage of at least two of the following: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

 - Solid understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework and ability to work across EU/local requirements

 - Proven ability to lead compliance projects cross-functionally: you translate regulatory requirements into clear priorities, align internal stakeholders, and deliver without creating bottlenecks or increased friction

 - Bilingual French/English (both required, written and spoken)

 - International exposure is a strong plus

You Will Thrive Here If You Are

 - A pragmatic problem-solver: you find the right answer within regulatory constraints rather than defaulting to the most conservative one

⭐ YOUR MISSION




MAIN MISSION

Build and execute on Alan's social media organic strategy internationally in order to turn Alan into the undisputed health reference on socials:

 - define Alan's unique voice on social media

 - drive the online conversation about health

 - build our AI-powered production system for scalable content production, and grow engaged communities across platforms

 - execute the social media strategy in France
   
   


DETAILED MISSIONS

1. Build the organic social media strategy

Global role:

 - Define Alan's social voice, creative direction, and platform-specific frameworks (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube), including which personas to target on each channel

 - Drive coordination with Brand, Product Marketing, and Growth to ensure social is embedded in every major moment (product launches, campaigns, events)

 - Bridge organic and paid efforts on Meta and YouTube, ensuring both work in concert to maximize reach, consistency, and performance

 - Align with each country team on editorial pillars (key themes and topics reflecting Alan's positioning) and platform priorities (which channels to activate and at what intensity per market)

 - Set the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness surveys, and social listening, with regular performance reviews shared cross-functionally

France execution:

 - Own and execute the France organic social strategy end-to-end, across the full content mix: educational content, product storytelling, employer brand, community engagement, and campaign amplification

 - Ensure France content is consistent with global frameworks while reflecting local market nuances

2. Build and operate an AI-powered content production and distribution engine

 - Design and implement an agentic content workflow using AI tools (LLMs, image generation, video automation) to dramatically increase production velocity without proportional headcount growth

 - Create a scalable system where subject-matter experts across the company (product, medical, growth, country teams) feed raw inputs (data, stories, product updates) that get transformed into publish-ready content at scale

 - Define and operate the distribution logic: publishing cadence, platform-specific formatting, timing, and scheduling across all active channels


3. Build a solid performance and measurement framework

 - Set up and own the measurement framework: follower composition, UTM tracking, brand awareness, social listening

 - Share regular performance reviews cross-functionally

 - Define KPIs connecting social activity to business outcomes (traffic, brand awareness, audience quality)

 - Use data to make autonomous editorial decisions and iterate on content strategy


KEY OUTCOMES BY 1 YEAR

 1. A clear, living organic social media strategy is in place and understood across Alan — platforms are prioritized, editorial pillars are defined, and Brand, Product Marketing, Growth, and country teams are aligned on what Alan stands for on social and how to contribute to it

 2. An AI-powered content production system is operational : agentic workflows handle scheduling, drafting, and basic repurposing, freeing up human time for creative strategy and high-value content

 3. Platform activation and posting cadence have been defined and implemented based on audience data and strategic priorities

 4. A measurement framework is live : we know who follows us, whether content drives traffic, and whether brand awareness among target audiences is moving

 5. Social has demonstrably amplified at least 2 major brand campaigns: the person has owned the organic social amplification strategy end-to-end for at least two significant brand moments, with measurable contribution to reach and engagement vs. previous benchmarks

Social strategy & editorial thinking

 - Able to build a platform-specific organic social media strategy from scratch: define objectives, prioritize platforms, set an editorial calendar, and adapt the approach based on data

 - Strong editorial judgment: knows what Alan should say, how, and where, and can make fast, autonomous decisions decisively

Content production

 - Can produce social-first content autonomously across formats (short video, carousel, static, copy-led posts), both hands-on and through AI-assisted workflows

 - Experienced with AI tools for content creation and able to design agentic pipelines

 - Has an eye for what works natively on each platform, not someone who repurposes the same content everywhere

Data & analytics

 - Able to read social analytics and turn them into actionable editorial decisions

 - Experienced building simple and rigorous reporting frameworks

 


SOFT SKILLS / BEHAVIOURAL TRAITS

 - Ownership mindset : takes full responsibility for the social presence

 - Systems thinker : thinks in workflows and leverage points, not just individual posts

 - Scrappy and resourceful : comfortable with frugality — finds creative solutions with limited budget, doesn't need a big production team to produce great content

 - Curious and fast-learning : obsessed with what's new on social, on AI tools, on platform algorithm changes — and translates that curiosity into experiments

 - Collaborative: builds strong working relationships across teams, communicates clearly, and makes it easy for others to contribute to social

 - Strategic and business-aware: understands that social is a business tool, so is able to balance reach and engagement with brand coherence, audience quality, and broader company objectives

 - Comfortable with ambiguity : the social strategy is not fully defined yet. This person needs to be energized by building on a blank page, not paralyzed by it

 - French : native level, perfect written syntax — the majority of content will be in French

 - English : fluent (working language at Alan, used daily)

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.




🛡️ YOUR MISSION: GOVERNANCE, RISK & COMPLIANCE

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.




⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.




🤝 WHAT YOU WILL ALSO DO: TECHNICAL ENABLEMENT

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

In France, every employee is entitled to a doctor whose job is to ensure they stay healthy at work. On paper: yearly check-ups, prevention plans, workplace risk assessments, return-to-work visits. In practice: an under-invested corner of French healthcare, with medical teams drowning in paperwork instead of doing medicine, and expediting visit after visit with little care as a result.

We think that's backwards. If millions of French workers each get to see an occupational health doctor multiple times in their career, that's one of the biggest untapped prevention channels in the country - and we're going to make it live up to its promise.

Alan Tech is building the tech and operations behind Prévenir https://prevenir.fr/, a brand new occupational health service, since 2025. We're building a proprietary medical stack from scratch, scaling operations to dozens of thousands of workers, and just opened Prévenir's first physical medical center in Paris - inside the Alan building.

A startup inside the startup: Prévenir has its own product, its own P&L, its own regulatory framework, and its own medical team. You get the autonomy and pace of a 0-to-1 team, sitting inside one of Europe's fastest-growing healthtechs, with access to Alan's expertise, its stack, and its ecosystem.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

 - Our AI-first medical software used by dozens of health professionals every day: patient file, consultation audio transcription, workplace risks, video consultation, appointment scheduling, everything is a seamless and time-saving way.

 - The customer setup machinery making all the affiliation, contracting, billing, or risk declaration complexity super simple for HRs.

 - Onsite member experience: you'll help design and implement the best experience possible for workers and health professionals alike, both online and onsite in our brand new medical center located on the first floor of our Paris office.

You'll work closely with doctors and nurses, Product Designers, User Researchers, Operations folks, and with other eng teams across Alan. A large portion of the team is composed of ex-entrepreneurs, so if you ever considered launching your own business one day, our team might be the best place to learn the ropes.




⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Zero-to-one and immediate Impact: we're still early in our adventure and there is so much to build! You won't be focusing on improving some metric by 1%, you will be creating entirely new features. 

 - Impact in both the physical and the digital space: while most of Alan's touchpoints are digital, we get to see many of our members in real life, unlocking opportunities to build completely new experiences beyond a phone screen.

 - Direct collaboration with the medical team: working with them to understand their needs and co-build the best possible technical solution is super rewarding.

 - Growth opportunity: our team is among the most experienced at Alan, making it a perfect fit if you're willing to learn from the best and grow your skillset!
   
   


🛠️ THE STACK

 - Python/Flask, React, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

 - 2+ years shipping prod-quality fullstack features - backend or frontend specialization is fine as long as you're comfortable with both.

 - Zero-to-one: you love building new products from scratch and are comfortable with the associated ambiguity

Mission Alignment:

 - Healthcare technology excites you

🌍 FOR THIS ROLE, YOU NEED TO BE BASED IN FRANCE, BELGIUM OR SPAIN 🌍



The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

Their core responsibilities (+- 70/80% of the time) are to:

 - Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

 - Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

 - Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

 - Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

 - Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

 - Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

 - Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

 - Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …




⭐️ OUR RUN ORGANISATION ⭐️

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Billing Platform
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ BUILD THE BACKBONE OF ALAN’S FINANCIAL SYSTEMS

Billing is the platform behind every euro that flows through Alan, invoicing 40K+ companies across multiple countries and products with total accuracy. Our mission: turn complex, high-volume financial flows into systems that "just work," so members and companies never have to think about them.

As a Software Engineer on this team, you will:

 - Build the core billing engine: process high volumes of transactions daily with precision and reliability.

 - Design modular, reusable billing primitives and abstractions that scale across products and regions.

 - Integrate seamlessly with internal systems and external payment platforms.

 - Automate workflows and billing schedules at scale for companies of all sizes.

 - Ensure invoices are accurate, reliable, and easy to manage for internal and external users.

 - Collaborate closely with product, design, and operations to maintain a unified, high-quality platform experience.




WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL:

 - Solve technically challenging problems in a mission-critical, high-scale platform.

 - Shape the architecture of Alan’s core financial systems and long-term product strategy.

 - Impact millions of members and clients, by making money movement invisible and hassle-free.

 - Join a team obsessed with craftsmanship, scalability, and operational excellence.

 - Work in an environment where your ideas, designs, and decisions drive tangible outcomes.




🛠 YOUR PLAYGROUND

 - Stack: Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

 - What you’ll do: ship scalable, reliable systems and build the backbone of Alan’s billing operations.

 - Impact: your work directly unlocks new services, countries, and exciting deals. It then supports their reliable operation.
   
   


👥 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Engineers of all experience levels, the quality of your thinking matters more than years on a resume.

 - Passionate about navigating complex business logic and system dependencies.

 - Experienced with scalable, resilient platform design.

 - Well-versed in OOP languages (Python, Java, C#).

 - Fluent in English (French is a plus but not required).

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Fair rewards & equity packages.

 - Flexible office & remote options.

 - Top-tier equipment: MacBook Pro, monitor, noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation & hours.

 - Comprehensive healthcare for you, children, and partners.

 - Transport support and coaching for personal growth.

 - Training budget for conferences, courses, books.

 - Extended parental leave for all parents.

🌟 We hire people, not roles. Don’t worry if you don’t check every box - high potential and curiosity matter most. We may even suggest another team if we see a better fit.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




⭐️ THE ROLE: PRODUCT LEAD, GROWTH ⭐️

At Alan, everyone is first and foremost an individual contributor. Product Managers at Alan are responsible for going deep on user needs, defining a product strategy, and turning it into a high impact product roadmap.

 - You'll work closely with designers, engineers and ops to define the right product and implement it.

 - You'll partner and align with all parts of the business: Marketing, Sales, Brand, and Data.



About the Growth area

Growth owns everything that happens before someone becomes a member: how prospects find Alan, how they decide we're right for them, and how they start. It runs across two crews.

 - Conversion: the conversion flows and referral surfaces that turn prospects into members.

 - Growth Infrastructure: the website, marketing measurement, and marketing ops that make growth marketing efficient.

You'll own the product across both crews. You'll set the overarching product vision, manage the PMs, push experimentation velocity, and lead Alan's move to make Growth Product AI-native.



More specifically, this means the following.



Lead Alan's AI ambition in Growth

The way people discover and buy insurance is about to change, and we want Alan ahead of it. You'll set the agenda and ship against it:

 - Conversational AI that guides prospects through our sales flows.

 - AI-native acquisition surfaces.

 - Alan inside LLM ecosystems. Picture a GPT app where a prospect can shop for and buy health insurance, and agentic commerce more broadly.

You don't need to have built all of this before. You do need a real, opinionated view of where AI is going, and the drive to turn it into shipped product rather than decks.



Build an experimentation engine

Conversion is won by learning faster than anyone else.

We have achieved a first baseline of A/B testing, learning loops, and a clear shared bar for what actually counts as a win. Now we want to take it to the next level. You'll improve our experimentation culture and the velocity.



Give the area a coherent vision

You'll align the Conversion and Growth Infrastructure roadmaps and concentrate the team's bets where the leverage is.

Two bigger shifts sit in your scope. Alan is going from one product to many, and Growth needs to move from a single conversion flow toward something modular. We're also scaling a self-served model built to travel fast, so it can reach a new country quickly with controlled local adaptation.



Build the team

You'll manage the PMs in the area and contribute to people topics for all product communities in the area (Design, Engineering, Data, Insurance). That means hiring, coaching, raising the bar on craft, and running a team that owns its outcomes. Continuously increasing talent density is a key part of this job.




⭐️ ABOUT YOU ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:



 - 6+ years of product related experience, currently at Lead or Group PM level, or as a Founder. You've owned strategy for a whole area, not a single team.

 - You've managed product managers directly. Hiring, coaching, hard feedback, performance calls. This is a hard requirement, not a grow-into.

 - You've shipped real growth product yourself: conversion, activation, or referral. You know funnel math, and you know a genuine win from a vanity one.

 - Experimentation is how you work, not something you ask others for. A/B testing, statistical significance, attribution. You can challenge a data team and catch a bad read.

 - You're hands-on in the engine room: event tracking, funnel analysis, experiment dashboards, growth instrumentation.

 - You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to bet and how LLM systems behave in production.

 - Ability to influence without authority: rallying distributed teams around shared vision and driving alignment across multiple stakeholders and geographies.

 - You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

PRODUCT MANAGER — SALES AI




⭐️ THE PRODUCT MANAGER ROLE ⭐️

Product Managers at Alan go deep on user needs, define a clear product strategy, and turn it into a high-impact roadmap.

 - You will work closely with designers, engineers and sales teams to define the right product and build it.

 - You will partner and align with every part of the business: sales, sales effectiveness, and our AI platform teams.



Sales AI: an exceptional opportunity to have an impact and grow

 - Our sales teams sell health insurance, a field that demands real expertise. Our internal tools have become powerful but fragmented, and AI is fundamentally reshaping how humans and tools interact. Alan’s growth ambitions are high: reaching them requires a step change in sales effectiveness — in time spent and in win rate.

 - So we are rethinking the entire sales experience from the ground up. Instead of tools Account Executives have to remember to open and prompt, we want an AI that works for the rep, including when they are not there: it processes information, analyzes a large pipeline of parallel deals, and comes back with “here is the priority today, do this and this.” A true assistant that helps reps prioritize, prepares work for them, and lets them build faster, more relevant offers, with the right sales material and arguments. With everything we know about past offers and the market, we can massively empower reps to walk in with a sharper offer and a sharper pitch.

 - The scope spans the full funnel: top funnel (automating prospection so reps get more, better-qualified discovery) and bottom funnel (winning offers, stronger pitches, higher win rate). Alan has strong maturity here: voice AI is live in France and Spain, outbound campaigns run autonomously, the CRM fills itself from call transcripts, and our offer copilot is used by more than half our reps — around 20% productivity gained this year. The limit today is structural: every capability lives in a separate tool, behind a manual trigger.

 - This is a validated, high-ambition bet to reinvent the sales experience, lift sales efficiency and win rate, and give every one of our clients a large-account-grade experience. And it does not stop at internal tooling: the same engine, pointed outward, can reach and answer customers directly in our self-serve funnel, and the approach can then be extended to other parts of Alan.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Reinvent the sales workflow. Move our Account Executives and Key Account Managers from siloed AI tools they have to remember to use, to AI that proactively pushes the right action at the right moment in their workflow.

 - Build and sequence the roadmap. The scope is broad, so you will decide where to start, prioritize the highest-impact automation over “nice to have” AI features, and sequence the path to the full vision.

 - Get hands-on. We build many of our tools in an “everyone can build” mode. You will work close to the engine room, writing prompts, wiring connectors and evaluating outputs, to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.

 - Empower better, faster selling. Bring together what we know about offers, content and market signals so reps produce sharper offers faster — and automate the prospection work that fills their pipeline in the first place.

 - Keep the experience coherent. Partner closely with adjacent teams building AI agents in neighboring areas, so the overall experience stays consistent rather than siloed.

 - Drive the outcomes. Minimize time spent on low-value work while lifting offer relevance, win rate and the volume of qualified conversations each rep can run — so their time goes only to what needs a human.




⭐️ ABOUT YOU ⭐️

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

 - At least 5 years in a product management role (or equivalent product ownership) in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment, ideally with AI or agentic products. Seniority matters here: the scope is exploratory and not fully defined yet.

 - Genuine excitement for AI. You have built AI products, or you are deeply eager to learn how LLM-based systems and agents behave in production, including their failure modes, and you can reason about the shift from pull-based to proactive, push-based experiences.

 - A builder mindset. You are hands-on and comfortable close to the product’s engine room (connectors, prompts, skills, evaluation) to understand what is really happening and unblock progress.

 - Appetite for the sales and insurance business. You are happy to sit with a rep, review an offer, and learn how guarantees and consumption terms are expressed, then turn that into product vision. You do not need to be a sales or insurance expert already, but you want to go deep fast.

 - Strong product execution. You set measurable goals, prioritize effectively, and ship iteratively, balancing quality, speed and impact.

 - The ability to bridge technical and non-technical worlds. You translate between platform and engineering constraints and sales reality, and drive alignment through clear framing and sharp decision-making.

 - Experience influencing without full authority. You can build the case for a new, ambitious bet and rally people around it.

 - Strong written communication in both internal and external-facing settings.

 - Fluency in French and English.

description:

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. 🐼 WHO WE ARE

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost center into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached 770M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You would join the team in charge of building smart products offering the most delightful and scalable Customer Service to 1M+ members.


We have developed a team of AI agents that brings immediate and personalized answers to about 50% of member's questions. 


And when it is not enough, we seamlessly transfer the question to our care experts team. We build the cockpit for that handoff and the tooling for the humans who take over.  It lets a care expert steer, correct, and supercharge the AI: routing requests, surfacing the right context at the right moment and drafting replies. The expert stays in command; the AI does the heavy lifting.




⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Direct Impact: Your decisions affect Alan’s scaling, growth, profitability and ability to provide delightful experience to members when they need it the most.

 - Human + AI, done right: You won't build AI that replaces people. You'll build the control surface that lets human experts drive the AI - the tools that decide what happens when the AI alone isn't enough.

 - Ownership & Growth: Influence product direction, mentor other engineers, and lead technical initiatives that shape the future of healthcare access.

 - 5+ years building scalable software systems

 - Full-stack experience (backend and frontend)

What we value:

 - You love turning complex problems into elegant solutions

 - You care about the "why" behind what you build, not just the "how"

 - Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority)

Mission Alignment:

 - Healthcare technology excites you

 - You understand that insurance isn't just about money - it's about access to care

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.




⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is React, Python/Flask, PostgreSQL in a monorepo. If you are not familiar with this stack but are a keen learner, it is totally fine. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.



What does make this role exciting :

 - The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

 - You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

 - You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

 - We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

 - Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ YOUR MISSION

We are building Alan in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes us known, trusted, and chosen.

As Alan's first marketing hire in Saudi, you will sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, working hand-in-hand with the Saudi GM. You won't wait for a playbook to be handed to you, you'll help write it, then execute it yourself. You'll be the one who turns Alan's global assets into locally resonant stories, generates the first pipeline signals, and builds the brand that makes the best companies in Riyadh want to be Alan customers.




YOUR MISSIONS WILL INCLUDE:

Strategy & Execution (in one role)

 - Work directly with the Saudi GM to build annual, quarterly & monthly go-to-market plans and execute the experiments yourself. This is a hands-on role — you own both the thinking and the doing.

 - Prioritise ruthlessly: in a market where Alan is not yet known, you'll sequence brand and awareness ahead of a mature inbound machine, and adjust as signals come in.

Brand, Comms & Social (your primary mandate)

You'll own how Alan shows up in Saudi and make it culturally resonant — this is what will actually make Alan cut through.

 - Establish Alan as a top-of-mind, trusted brand in Saudi, adapting Alan's global brand initiatives into locally and culturally relevant campaigns (Arabic-native, attuned to local moments and employer expectations).

 - Own organic social end-to-end — define Alan Saudi's social voice and editorial pillars, and activate the right platforms for a B2B and employer-brand audience (LinkedIn as anchor, plus Instagram/TikTok/YouTube as they fit), consistent with global frameworks but locally led.

 - Lead PR and comms for Saudi milestones — coordinate media opportunities and press releases to position Alan's voice in local health and employee-benefits conversations.

 - Bring strong copywriting and storytelling instincts — every word you write should earn its place.

What success looks like: Alan is increasingly known and trusted among target buyers in Saudi. Branded organic traffic and brand awareness are growing, social is building a qualified local audience, and Alan is showing up credibly in the market's conversations.


Content & SEO/GEO

 - Build and maintain Alan's Saudi website presence, ensuring it reflects local messaging and SEO/GEO priorities.

 - Produce and prioritise content (blogs, videos, social posts, adapting global playbooks) that builds awareness and creates organic search presence.

 - Localise Alan's global SEO/GEO playbook and rigorously track impact.

Events into inbound growth

Build repeatable event formats and make sure their impact extends beyond the room. You will support events by:

 - Supporting event logistics, timelines, registration pages, and materials

 - Creating follow-up emails and digital touchpoints after events

 - Turning event themes and conversations into content

 - Helping Sales follow up with the right people

 - Using event activity to create retargeting audiences, campaign inputs, and reusable content

What success looks like: Events that are well supported operationally and consistently translated into digital, content, and inbound inputs that can be reused over time.




👀 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You are a genuine swiss knife. You are equally comfortable writing a press release, building a landing page, and hosting a breakfast event for HR leaders. You don't wait for specialists:  your role spans across brand, growth, and product marketing. You spot and fill the gap yourself.

 - You go local first. You understand that global assets are a starting point, not a finish line. You naturally translate messages, visuals, and events into what resonates in the Saudi market.

 - You are data-driven, not opinion-driven. You define success metrics before you start. You know the difference between vanity metrics and the ones that actually move the pipeline.

 - You build to last. When you build something, you document it so it scales. You think in systems and playbooks, not one-offs.

 - You thrive in 0-to-1. The absence of a fully-built machine energises you rather than frustrates you. Ambiguity is something you resolve, not something you escalate.

 - You are a natural collaborator. You work closely with Sales, feed them what they need, and you're comfortable spending time in customer conversations to test your narratives and positiong live.

 


⭐️ REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE

Must-haves

 - 4–6 years of experience in growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup or scaleup environment

 - Demonstrated versatility across multiple mission areas (brand, content/SEO, events, product marketing)

 - Fluent in Arabic and English (written and spoken).

 - Strong copywriting and storytelling skills: can write compelling copy in both Arabic and English

 - Hands-on experience with paid platforms (Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads)

 - Comfort with data: can set up basic tracking, read dashboards, and iterate based on performance

 - Entrepreneurial mindset: a self-starter who doesn't need a 50-person team to make things happen

Nice to haves

 - Experience in B2B SaaS, healthtech, insurtech or HR tech

 - Familiarity with the Saudi or GCC business landscape and HR buyer profiles

 - Experience with SEO tools (Semrush, Ahrefs, Search Console)

 - Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms

 - Has worked as a first or early marketing hire before

Level target: C1–D on Alan's level grid 




⭐ WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary: we believe in paying well and trusting people to do great work

 - Meaningful equity: you are building this from scratch, and you should share in what you create

 - A world-class team to lean on: you won't be alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's international sales, product, and operations teams

 - Alan's health coverage (of course 😊)

 - The tools to do your best work: MacBook, the best software, and an environment built for focus

 - Real ownership and impact: you are not a cog in a machine. You are the machine.

title: Psychothérapeute - Québec
description:
La santé n'attend pas.

Pas le temps que les symptômes s'aggravent. Pas six mois d'attente pour un rendez-vous. Pas le temps que le système rattrape son retard. C'est pourtant ainsi que fonctionne la santé aujourd'hui : on attend, jusqu'à ne plus pouvoir.

Alan existe pour mettre fin à l'attente.

La santé est un droit universel, et nous sommes convaincus que ce droit ne prend tout son sens que lorsqu'il va de pair avec la prévention. Il faut cesser de voir la santé comme quelque chose que l'on répare pour la penser comme quelque chose que l'on construit, jour après jour. Ce n'est pas qu'une question de volonté : c'est le système de santé lui-même qui doit fonctionner pour tous, et de façon durable.

C'est pourquoi nous bâtissons la nouvelle référence en matière d'assurance prévention. Alan est la première entreprise à réunir l'assurance, la prévention et les soins dans une seule expérience, saluée par nos membres.

Nous vivons une aventure hors du commun : construire une entreprise de premier plan à l'échelle mondiale, portée par une culture unique https://alan.com/en/careers. Nous comptons déjà plus de 40 000 entreprises clientes de toutes tailles, couvrons plus d'un million de membres et avons dépassé les $1B d'ARR.

La prévention comme nouvelle norme : voilà ce que nous construisons avec notre équipe de plus de 800 personnes. Si cela vous parle, sachez que nous recrutons en France, en Espagne, en Belgique et au Canada. Et au-delà.


🐼 Qui sommes-nous ?



Vous. En mieux. Avec Alan.



La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme des soins, pour tous. Notre mission : aider chacun à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans, et permettre aux employeurs de faire des avantages santé leur investissement le plus précieux, plutôt qu'un simple centre de coûts.

Nous bâtissons un partenaire santé intégré de bout en bout, qui réunit sans couture l'assurance et une offre de soins intelligente au sein d'un même système.

En reliant toutes les dimensions du soin — privé, public et en accès direct — nous créons une expérience de santé pensée autour du membre. Nous accompagnons chacun pour prendre soin de soi au quotidien et vivre en meilleure santé.



🤘 Comment travaillons-nous ?

Celles et ceux qui rejoignent Alan sont toujours surpris et séduits par notre méthode de travail. Un ensemble de valeurs culturelles https://alan.com/about/company-culture guide notre façon de faire, parmi lesquelles :



🎯 Ce qui nous anime — Aider nos membres à vivre en meilleure santé



1. La mission avant tout : penser à long terme et placer la réussite de notre mission au premier plan.

2. Satisfaire le membre et le client : nous sommes entièrement tournés vers la résolution de leurs problèmes et la création des expériences les plus agréables.



🏆 Comment nous cultivons l'excellence — Recruter les meilleurs et leur donner les moyens de réussir



1. Champions de l'excellence : des standards très élevés et une forte densité de talents.

2. Responsabilité distribuée : des « despotes éclairés » qui assument pleinement leurs décisions et leurs résultats.

3. Radicalement transparents : toute l'information est accessible et couchée par écrit en priorité, pour que chacun décide au mieux, de façon asynchrone.



🤝 Comment nous progressons ensemble — Nous aider mutuellement grâce aux feedbacks honnêtes et à une pensée audacieuse



1. Alchimie optimiste : des optimistes qui collaborent avec une bienveillance sincère et soutiennent leurs coéquipiers.

2. Challengers empathiques : des feedbacks directs et bienveillants, doublés d'encouragements, pour progresser ensemble sur le plan professionnel.

3. Contrariens audacieux et créatifs : penser autrement et oser de nouvelles approches pour viser l'excellence.



⚡ Comment nous avançons rapidement — Combattre la complexité et nous concentrer sur l'essentiel



1. Rigoureux dans l'exécution : agir avec détermination et une concentration qui fait fructifier le succès dans la durée.

2. Se battre pour la simplicité : uniquement des processus à fort impact, et une frugalité intelligente.



🙌 Qui recherchons-nous ? 🙌



Nous recherchons un psychothérapeute pour notre nouveau service de téléthérapie destiné à nos membres au Québec. Si vous avez envie d'être à l'avant-garde de l'innovation et de rejoindre une équipe exceptionnelle, ce poste est fait pour vous. Fidèles à nos valeurs de simplicité, de transparence et de prévention, nous sommes pleinement mobilisés pour offrir une expérience remarquable aux Québécoises et aux Québécois, avec le lancement de notre service au Québec et partout au Canada 🇨🇦 (les permis valables dans plusieurs provinces sont donc les bienvenus !).



🌳 Critères de sélection :



* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit (langue maternelle ou niveau équivalent), les séances avec nos membres au Québec se déroulant majoritairement en français.

* Détenir le droit d'exercer la psychothérapie au Québec, c'est-à-dire l'un des statuts suivants :

    Psychologue membre en règle de l'Ordre des psychologues du Québec (OPQ) ; ou

    Titulaire du permis de psychothérapeute délivré par l'OPQ, à titre de membre en règle d'un ordre professionnel habilité — notamment l'Ordre des travailleurs sociaux et des thérapeutes conjugaux et familiaux du Québec (OTSTCFQ) ou l'Ordre des conseillers et conseillères d'orientation du Québec (OCCOQ) ; ou

   * Médecin membre du Collège des médecins du Québec autorisé à exercer la psychothérapie.

 Connaissance du français reconnue aux fins de l'admission à l'ordre professionnel : les personnes n'ayant pas fait leurs études en français doivent avoir réussi l'examen de français de l'Office québécois de la langue française (OQLF), conformément à la Charte de la langue française.

* Bonne connaissance de la TCC (thérapie cognitivo-comportementale), de la thérapie des schémas, de l'EMDR ou de la thérapie ACT.

* Des spécialités en phase avec les besoins de nos membres : stress, épuisement professionnel, estime de soi, dépression et traumatismes.

* Une spécialisation en thérapie auprès des adultes.

* De 5 à 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle au minimum.

* Une disponibilité d'au moins 3 heures par semaine.

* Une réelle aisance avec les outils et plateformes numériques.

* Une preuve d'assurance responsabilité professionnelle (minimum de 5 M$ CA).



⭐ Des atouts supplémentaires :



* La maîtrise d'une autre langue (anglais, espagnol, arabe, créole, etc.).

* Un permis d'exercice dans une autre province (p. ex. Ontario, Colombie-Britannique ou Alberta).

* Une formation en thérapie cognitive basée sur la pleine conscience (MBCT).



⚡️ Processus de recrutement :



Le processus se déroule en deux étapes. Vous pourrez bien sûr poser toutes vos questions : nous recherchons des personnes exceptionnelles et tenons à ce que vous mesuriez pleinement l'aventure qui vous attend.



* Premier entretien :

   * Rencontre avec l'équipe Alan (30-45 minutes), pour faire connaissance et préciser notre organisation et nos attentes.

* Deuxième entretien :

   * Entretien technique (45 minutes) avec Lydia Martin, responsable du programme mondial de santé mentale d'Alan. Titulaire d'un doctorat en psychologie, elle échangera avec vous sur votre expertise et vos connaissances thérapeutiques.



Feedback : dans l'esprit de transparence propre à Alan, nous nous efforçons de donner du feedback à chaque étape et de revenir vers vous sous 48 heures (les fins de semaine ne comptent pas !).



🙌 Avantages et privilèges



Chez Alan, vous contribuez à bâtir la plateforme de santé mentale de nouvelle génération, qui donne à de nombreuses personnes accès à un accompagnement personnalisé. Voici ce que nous offrons :



* Une rémunération attrayante.

* Une grande souplesse d'horaire et de lieu de travail : vous pouvez travailler depuis votre domicile ou votre cabinet (les rendez-vous avec nos membres se déroulent en téléconsultation).

* La possibilité de rejoindre une communauté soudée de thérapeutes, où grandir, échanger et apprendre ensemble.

* L'accès à une patientèle en croissance.

* La chance de contribuer à déstigmatiser la santé mentale et à y ancrer une approche préventive.

* La participation à une réunion d'équipe d'une heure chaque mois.



Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles.



Après avoir lu cette description, si vous avez le sentiment de ne pas réunir tous les prérequis, mais que le poste correspond à là où vous en êtes ou à ce vers quoi vous souhaitez évoluer, nous vous encourageons à postuler.



Tout le monde n'ira pas au bout de notre processus de recrutement, mais chacun, aussi sous-représenté soit-il, devrait se sentir libre de tenter sa chance : il n'y a que des apprentissages, ou des réussites, à en tirer.



🔖 Pour en savoir plus, consultez nos pages À propos d'Alan  https://alan.com/aboutet Carrières https://alan.com/careers, ainsi que notre Medium https://medium.com/alan, notre blogue https://blog.alan.com et notre page Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm.
