description:
🐻 Qui est Alan ?

En France, des millions de personnes renoncent aux soins faute de temps, d'accès ou de moyens. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.

La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.

Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :

 - 🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct

 - 💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes

 - 🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins

 - 🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés

 - 🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recrutons des médecins généralistes à l'aise avec le soin à distance et motivé(e)s pour nous rejoindre sur notre service de téléconsultation. Ce qui compte pour nous autant que vos compétences médicales : votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance à distance, avec bienveillance et sans compromis sur la qualité des soins.

 - ✅ À l'aise avec les outils numériques

 - ✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)

 - ✅ Statut salarié

 - ✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients

🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?

 - 🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conformes aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles, des pairs sont disponibles pour échanger, et vous pouvez solliciter des spécialistes de l'équipe comme dans une vraie structure de soin.

 - ✨ Une médecine de qualité. Grâce au chat médical et à Mo, chaque membre est orienté vers le bon parcours avant même de consulter. Quand une téléconsultation a lieu, elle est vraiment nécessaire. Vous pouvez accorder le temps qu'il faut à chaque patient, sans pression sur le nombre de consultations.

 - 🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin ? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et contribuent à faire évoluer les pratiques.

 - 💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (à partir de 72€/h), une flexibilité d’organisation et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée, ainsi que la mutuelle Alan prise en charge à 100 % !

title: 🌐 Security & Legal Specialist - Customer Care
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.




🚀 THE CHALLENGE

 - Alan is a leading European health insurer with over 1 million members across 4 countries (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada). At its core, Alan is a tech company that believes exceptional member experience is a competitive advantage:  fast, empathetic, and reliable service at scale. As of Q1 2026, 40% of conversations are handled automatically.

 - At the intersection of Care, Legal, Security, and Data Protection sits a set of topics that are as operationally complex as they are strategically critical: data breaches, GDPR rights requests, security incidents, legal complaints, regulatory reporting.

 - We are looking for a Care Legal & Security Specialist to own these topics end-to-end: handling complex cases in close collaboration with Alan's Legal and DPO teams, building the processes and training that allow our ~300 Care agents to manage them with confidence, and identifying where AI and automation can reduce manual load. As Alan accelerates across four countries, what you build in France gets replicated in Spain, Belgium, and Canada: your work doesn't stay local.

 - This is not a pure legal role, and it is not a pure ops role. You handle regulatory cases, improve the processes that prevent them from recurring, and scale what works across countries. You will be embedded within our Operational Excellence team, working in close collaboration with Care Ops and the Corporate Unit.
   
   
   
   
   👨‍🚀 MISSIONS
   
   
   
   1/ Operational run

 - Handle complex security incidents, GDPR cases, and legal complaints escalated from Care agents, including CNIL notifications (drafted in close collaboration with Legal and DPO, within the 72-hour regulatory deadline), account takeover situations, Level 2 and Level 3 complaints, and incoming legal mail

 - Manage interactions with external stakeholders (CNIL, Insurance Ombudsman, Signal Conso) with precision and within regulatory deadlines

 - Own KPI monitoring and reporting for legal and security matters; organize yearly complaints reporting for Alan's Board; identify trends and escalate systemic issues to Product teams early
   
   
   
   2/ Scalability: process, tools, and training

 - Design and continuously improve workflows, escalation paths, macros, and help center content so Care agents can handle legal and security cases autonomously at L1 and L2

 - Identify simplification and automation opportunities across legal and security operations, then collaborate with Care Ops and Product crews to deploy them, rather than solving each case manually

 - Build and maintain training materials (case studies, Q&As, simulations), so Care Experts develop real judgment, not just process familiarity

 - Ensure regulatory training completion across the team
   
   
   
   3/ Globalization

 - Translate processes, frameworks, and training materials built for France into resources that Care and Legal/Compliance teams in other countries can adopt

 - Coordinate actively with counterparts in other countries to share learnings, align on best practices, and anticipate regulatory divergences

 - Build shared resources so that when a new country goes live, the Care Legal & Security function isn't starting from scratch
   
   
   
   4/ Mentorship and cross-collaboration

 - Support Care Experts participating in the Legal & Security taskforce: build their judgment on complex and ambiguous cases, be the primary escalation reference for Care agents facing difficult legal or security situations

 - Collaborate with the Corporate Unit Lead and Care Ops to shape the Care roadmap on legal and security topics; translate regulatory constraints into executable processes and surface operational insights that should inform policy or product decisions
   
   
   
   
   ⭐ YOU'LL EXCEL IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Deliver reliably on high-stakes, deadline-driven cases with a real member-centric mindset

 - Have at least 1-2 years of experience in one of the following: GDPR / privacy operations, legal complaints handling in a regulated sector, or compliance ops in fintech, insurtech, or health

 - Communicate with precision and adapt to your audience, whether you're briefing a legal expert, aligning with a product team, or coaching a front-line agent. You get buy-in from agents and managers who didn't ask for a new process, and that's as important as designing the process itself

 - Spot simplification opportunities and know how to turn them into projects: you identify what should be automated or redesigned, then drive the collaboration with Care Ops and Product to make it happen

 - Are comfortable navigating regulatory frameworks (GDPR, complaint handling, CNIL) without being a lawyer; you know when to escalate and when to own it, and you're backed by Legal and DPO experts at Alan

 - Are comfortable making judgment calls in ambiguous situations and moving forward without waiting for all the answers.

 - Are fluent in French (C1+ written and spoken,  essential for CNIL notifications, ombudsman responses, and legal correspondence) and proficient in English for internal Alan collaboration
   
   No prior legal qualification is required but a background in law is a genuine plus. We are looking for operational rigor, strong communication, and the appetite to build something that scales.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B-C level range.




🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France.

Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.




YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

ALAN IS LOOKING FOR A GLOBAL BRAND EVENT MANAGER TO TURN EVENTS INTO A DISTINCTIVE, SCALABLE EXPRESSION OF THE ALAN BRAND. THE ROLE COMBINES EVENT STRATEGY, BRAND EXPERIENCE, OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE, COMMERCIAL UNDERSTANDING, AND COMMUNITY BUILDING.

You will own Alan’s yearly flagship event, building on the success of Alan 10, and help make it an even stronger moment for brand, community, customers, prospects, partners, and the wider healthcare ecosystem. Beyond the flagship event, you will build the operating system that enables commercial and local teams to run high-quality events repeatedly and consistently.

It is a senior individual-contributor role that owns the global event system and makes other teams more autonomous and effective.

 

You will lead the global strategy and execution of Alan’s major Brand events, while owning the execution of local Brand events in France. You will create the playbooks, standards, templates, and measurement frameworks that allow teams across markets to deliver high-quality events without reinventing the wheel each time.

You will also contribute to the Brand team’s global community-event strategy, identifying the formats and moments that can make Alan more visible, credible, and memorable to the communities we want to influence.

You’ll equip local teams with the right local approach and assets, and support them as they adapt and run events in their markets.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 1. Own Alan’s yearly flagship event
    
    - Participate in the definition of the event’s purpose, audience, positioning, narrative, and success criteria.
    
    - Build the event roadmap, budget, and production plan.
    
    - Manage agencies, venues, suppliers, speakers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
    
    - Coordinate content, creative, production, guest management, press, influencers, Sales, and local market teams.
    
    - Design a high-quality guest experience before, during, and after the event.
    
    - Connect invitations, registration, CRM tracking, attendance, and follow-up.
    
    - Run rehearsals, speaker preparation, run-of-show management, and on-site execution.

 2. Build Alan’s recurring event playbook
    
    - Define the main event formats and their intended purposes, such as owned events, executive dinners, round tables, speaking opportunities, trade shows, and partner events.
    
    - Create practical templates for briefs, timelines, budgets, approvals, execution, production, and follow-up.
    
    - Help define the role of commercial teams before, during, and after the event.
    
    - Create reusable content, event assets, checklists, and quality standards.

 3. Support local teams on local events
    
    - Help local teams choose the right format and define the desired outcome.
    
    - Review briefs and plans, provide feedback, and raise the quality bar.
    
    - Identify successful local formats that could be scaled globally.

 4. Help shape and execute Alan’s community-event strategy
    
    - Contribute with the Brand team to the Community building strategy
    
    - Design recurring event franchises and formats.
    
    - Build partnerships with relevant organizations, experts, customers, and opinion leaders.
    
    - Run test-and-learn initiatives that can start locally and scale globally.




PROFILE & COMPETENCIES

We are looking for someone who has:

 - At least 5 years of experience delivering events end to end, ideally in a Brand, B2B marketing, field marketing, agency environment.

 - Experience running complex events with multiple stakeholders, suppliers, agencies, speakers (including profiles with special logistics and security needs), and audience types.

 - Strong event production skills, including planning, budgeting, timelines, vendor management, risk management, rehearsals, and on-site delivery.

 - Experience building repeatable processes, playbooks, templates, or operating models.

 - A strong understanding of how events can support brand awareness, community building, customer relationships, and commercial outcomes.

 - Experience working with Sales, Customer Marketing, PR, Creative, Communications, and local market teams.

 - Comfort with CRM, registration, lead capture, attribution, and post-event follow-up processes.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

 - Based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

 - Willingness to travel and work across international markets.

title: General Manager Associate - Armenia
description:
Europe’s fastest-growing one-stop health partner is expanding to Armenia. Join the team as one of the first employees in Armenia and build the future of health.




🐼 WHO WE ARE



Alan https://alan.com/ is Europe's fastest-growing one-stop health partner, on track to become a global healthcare giant by 2030.



We empower 1m+ members across 35,000+ companies, generating €800m+ in annual recurring revenue and growing +50% last year. Our latest round valued Alan at €5bn, with world-class investors (e.g., Index Ventures, Temasek, Coatue, OTPP, Ribbit).

Our vision: make prevention the new norm of care for all.

Our mission: help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

Our approach: build the vertically integrated payor and provider, uniting full-stack insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one seamless system. We are the ultimate one-stop health partner for people and companies.

Our team of around 700 people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, Canada 🇨🇦. And now, we’re expanding in Armenia 🇦🇲.




⭐️ GENERAL MANAGER (GM) ASSOCIATE - ARMENIA ⭐️



As the Armenia General Manager's Associate, you will be the General Manager's right hand in building and scaling a transformed Armenian healthcare system from the ground up. This isn't just a job - it's a once-in-a-career opportunity to transform healthcare. 



You will support execution of our strategy in the short term while helping build our long-term vision, ensuring alignment across the Armenian team. You will benefit from support, resources, and expertise from the global Alan platform.




YOUR MISSION

You'll own high-impact work across the business - strategy, operations, growth, partnerships, team building. You’ll wear many hats (we can’t list them all), but your core missions include:

 - Owning end-to-end execution of strategic initiatives - from strategy definition to operational setup and local implementation. You'll lead the full cycle with accountability for results.

 - Building the system from scratch - you'll move fast through stakeholder mapping, partnership development, process building, and team scaling.

 - Working closely with the General Manager as well as an Ops builder to define the right strategy and execute it.

 - Integrating the Armenia business into our global operations - work cross-functionally with teams across 5 countries to leverage Alan's proven playbook while adapting for Armenia's unique operational dynamics.

 - Leading through influence and clarity - you'll communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly, keeping stakeholders aligned. You'll write strategy docs, business plans, and updates that help teams make decisions autonomously.




YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT AT ALAN IF YOU HAVE

 - 3-5 years of experience building businesses or driving growth in management consulting, investment banking, M&A, or as an operator at a high-growth startup/scaleup, or founder.

 - Fluency in Armenian and English (written and spoken).

 - Based in Yerevan, with a deep understanding of the local market, culture, healthcare landscape, and business environment.

 - Strategic thinking with hands-on execution: you define strategy and inspire teams while also getting into the details, from running customer meetings to building financial models to negotiating partnerships.

 - Strong organization, time management and autonomy: you are well-versed in missions requiring precision and reliability. You are able to manage a project from start to finish with minimal external assistance.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset: you're comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership beyond your job description, and find creative solutions to hard problems.

 - Mission-driven: you have the will to challenge the status quo and transform the healthcare industry in Armenia.

 - (As a plus) Knowledge of French, experience with international teams, or track record in scaling organizations/healthcare/insurance.




MORE INFORMATION

 - About Alan https://alan.com/about

 - Letter to shareholders Q3 2025 https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-2025-q3-letter-to-shareholders

 - Life at Alan https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan and our culture https://alan.com/about/company-culture

⭐ THE PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER B2C OPPORTUNITY

Building the engagement engine with Alan Play that makes 500k members come back to their health every single day, a key differentiator for Alan.

 

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. Play is Alan's #1 source of traffic and the retention engine of all our health services. And we are B2B2C: companies pay, members choose to engage. Play is a differentiator in deals, and at renewal. HR admins are also an underused distribution channel to reach members. Two audiences, one product story. By 2030 we want 500k daily users, across all our countries

 

The challenges: Our lifecycle is greenfield. Onboarding, activation, reminders, reactivation and win-back are owned by nobody today. We run events rebuilt almost from scratch, so the tenth Alan Cup costs as much as the first. We measure opens and clicks, not what a campaign actually did to daily engagement. And on the B2B side, our pitch goes stale between releases, as Play ships fast, so the sales argument does not keep up.

 

The future: A lifecycle layer designed for personalisation, running on the segmentation and experimentation platform Play has been building. Campaign machinery that gets cheaper every quarter. A measurement loop we trust, with holdouts and real incrementality. A live Play pitch that updates as features ship, so the field walks into a renewal or a deal with the current product. And HR admins turned into a real, measured distribution channel rather than a mailing list.

 

The hard parts: This role is horizontal, and vertical. Many member segments, many admin segments, several countries, coordination with Product as well as Sales, KAM and CSM, as well as other products teams who communicate with members.

 


⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

 


MUST HAVES

 - Retention and lifecycle marketing at scale on a consumer product - subscription, gaming, social, media, health and fitness. Where engagement and retention are the business.

 - You build systems, not just campaigns - you can walk us through machinery you built that made the next campaign cheaper, and tell us what it cost you to get it adopted.

 - Analytical rigour - you read a funnel, design a segment, set up a holdout, call a result. You are comfortable being accountable to a product metric.

 - Horizontal operator - you have held many audiences and several countries at once. Volume and context switching, not depth on a single vertical.

title: Product Lead - Armenia
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐THE PRODUCT LEAD ROLE ⭐

The Product Lead for Armenia will drive Alan's product strategy and execution in supporting the transformation of healthcare in Armenia. This role involves leading dedicated product teams (designers, engineers) while coordinating with global product areas and a local operations team to deliver on Alan's contractual obligations and member experience goals.




📈KEY OUTCOMES📈

 1. Develop and execute a product strategy that serves both the government's public health objectives and the members' experience, supporting our targets in terms of coverage rollout, member satisfaction, and operational reliability under the concession's contractual commitments.

 2. Lead product crews to deliver product enhancements and new features, demonstrating effective leadership and prioritization across parallel workstreams with shared dependencies.

 3. Collaborate with global product areas to ensure the Armenian system benefits from global innovations, adapting them as necessary to fit the B2G model and local healthcare context.

 4. Partner with the local operations team, government relations, customer care, and the national health IT platform to align product development with operational readiness and regulatory expectations.

 5. Implement data-driven decision-making processes, utilizing analytics to inform product strategy and measure the impact of product changes on member access, operational efficiency, and government trust.

 6. Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the product team, encouraging experimentation and learning from both successes and failures.




⭐IS IT WHAT YOU ARE LOOKING FOR?⭐


️
YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT AT ALAN IF YOU HAVE:

 - At least 6 years of experience in a product-related role (Product Manager, Founder, Business strategy) with a track record of delivering complex systems at scale.

 - A history of working on software products that delight users in a fast-paced environment from ideation to release.

 - Proven experience in product management, ideally involving B2G, public sector, or regulated environments where the end user and the paying entity are different stakeholders.

 - Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable product strategies under high uncertainty and political sensitivity.

 - Excellent leadership and communication skills, capable of leading cross-functional teams and collaborating with stakeholders ranging from engineers to government officials.

 - Fluent in English. Proficiency in Armenian is a strong plus.

 - Experience in healthcare, insurance, or government services is a plus, but not required.

 - (As a plus) Ability to work with distributed teams and coordinate efforts across different geographical locations.



We are looking for someone who wants to build something meaningful from the ground up, with a high level of ownership and a lot of room to shape the role.

We hire people, not roles. If this opportunity speaks to you, we would love to hear from you.

title: Directeur Financier - Afrique de l'Ouest
description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐️ LA FINANCE CHEZ ALAN ⭐️

La Finance chez Alan, c’est l’équipe qui bâtit le socle financier permettant de piloter une assurance santé digitale en pleine croissance, sur des marchés où presque tout reste à construire.

Le cœur de nos responsabilités : produire une information financière fiable pour chacune de nos entités, tenir des comptes toujours prêts pour la clôture, et donner à l’entreprise les chiffres sur lesquels elle peut s’appuyer pour décider. Au quotidien, cela signifie tenir la comptabilité, piloter les clôtures, coordonner les cabinets externes, suivre la trésorerie et pousser l’automatisation dans un contexte multi-pays et multi-devises.

Nous réunissons une diversité de profils :

 - Des profils qui structurent : définition du modèle de reporting, des normes et des processus financiers,

 - Des profils qui délivrent : une production comptable et un reporting d’excellence au quotidien, tout en améliorant en continu ce que nous faisons.

Nous recherchons des membres d’équipe prêts à instaurer des standards financiers de classe mondiale sur des marchés qui les méritent, et à en faire un véritable avantage.




⭐️ LE RÔLE DE DIRECTEUR FINANCIER ⭐️

Nous recherchons un(e) responsable financier(ère) expérimenté(e) et opérationnel(le) pour porter l’ensemble de la fonction finance de nos activités en Afrique de l’Ouest.

Vous serez le point unique de responsabilité sur la façon dont ce périmètre est piloté et reporté. Basé(e) à Dakar, vous ferez le lien entre les équipes locales, les cabinets externes et la maison-mère. En détail, vos missions comprendront :

 - Piloter le reporting de l’ensemble du périmètre : produire chaque mois le compte de résultat, le bilan et la situation de trésorerie de chaque entité et les intégrer proprement dans le reporting mensuel global.

 - Coordonner les comptables et les cabinets : animer une équipe de comptables et la relation avec les cabinets d’expertise-comptable externes de chaque entité — fixer le calendrier de clôture, revoir leurs livrables et tenir le niveau de qualité.

 - Piloter la clôture et les contrôles : assurer une clôture mensuelle fiable sur l’ensemble des entités et des devises (FCFA et USD), porter les rapprochements et mettre en place les contrôles nécessaires à mesure que l’activité se rapproche de comptes prêts pour l’audit.

 - Assurer le lien avec la maison-mère : être l’interlocuteur(rice) finance du groupe — traduire les réalités locales en standards de reporting, répondre aux demandes de données et soutenir la consolidation.

 - Améliorer, automatiser et faire grandir l’équipe : challenger et fluidifier les processus financiers pour réduire le travail manuel et accélérer le reporting, et participer au recrutement, à l’onboarding et à la montée en compétences de l’équipe finance locale.

Vous travaillerez en grande autonomie, en collaboration étroite avec les équipes centrales Finance, Data et Trésorerie.




⭐️ UNE OPPORTUNITÉ UNIQUE DE PARTICIPER À QUELQUE CHOSE D'HISTORIQUE ⭐️

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, vous serez aux avant-postes d'une véritable révolution de la santé en Afrique de l'Ouest. Vous contribuerez à bâtir la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle d'une entreprise passant de 30 000 à des centaines de milliers de membres, de deux pays à un continent entier.

Vous vivrez l'énergie d'une startup rapide, portée par ses fondateurs et en pleine croissance. Ce n'est pas un poste d'opérations ordinaire : vous opérerez sur un marché où tout est à construire, et où votre travail aura un impact direct et visible sur la vie des gens.




⭐️ VOUS ÊTES PEUT-ÊTRE LA BONNE PERSONNE SI… ⭐️

 - Vous avez plus de 6 ans d’expérience en comptabilité/finance, avec une réelle responsabilité dans une clôture multi-entités.

 - Vous maîtrisez les normes SYSCOHADA / OHADA et la fiscalité locale (TVA, IS/BIC).

 - Vous avez fait vos preuves dans le management de comptables et de cabinets externes, la définition de standards et la tenue d’un calendrier de production, vous faites fonctionner un dispositif financier distribué dans les délais.

 - Vous êtes rigoureux(se), autonome, proactif(ve) et orienté(e) solution.

 - Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) communicant(e), à l’aise pour faire le pont entre des équipes locales et des interlocuteurs internationaux.

 - Vous êtes parfaitement à l’aise en français et en anglais (langue de travail du groupe).
   
   

C’est encore mieux si vous avez :

 - Une expérience en assurance santé, en mutuelle (IPM/mutuelle) ou dans un environnement de gestion pour compte de tiers (TPA).

 - Une bonne connaissance de l’environnement réglementaire au Sénégal ou en Côte d’Ivoire ; une expérience de consolidation (US GAAP ou IFRS/normes françaises) est un plus.

 - Des compétences en data et en automatisation pour fiabiliser et accélérer le reporting.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI.

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.




🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES.

Si cette opportunité vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Toutes les personnes, y compris celles issues de groupes sous-représentés, devraient se sentir libres de postuler : soit on réussit, soit on apprend. Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. #LI-DNP

description:

🤹 LES OPÉRATIONS CHEZ ALAN

Les opérations sont une fonction stratégique. Nous définissons la vision, construisons les systèmes et pilotons les résultats qui rendent possible l’assurance santé digitale et le parcours de santé à grande échelle, sur des marchés où tout reste à inventer.

L’équipe Opérations développe nos capacités opérationnelles et fait évoluer efficacement notre plateforme afin d’accompagner la croissance, d’optimiser les coûts et les ressources, et de diversifier nos produits. Nous avançons vite, avec un fort niveau de responsabilité, et sommes fiers de nous attaquer à des problèmes complexes.

Nous recherchons des personnes prêtes à réinventer, et pas simplement améliorer, l’assurance et la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, afin de transformer l’expérience de nos membres et de nos clients entreprises.

La description du poste est simple : définir la vision, prendre les décisions difficiles, délivrer et assumer les résultats.

En tant qu’Operations Builder, vous construirez et développerez l’infrastructure opérationnelle qui nous permettra de passer de 30 000 à plusieurs centaines de milliers de membres en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Vous prendrez en charge des problématiques critiques et ambiguës, avec un impact direct et visible sur nos membres au quotidien.


EXEMPLES DE SUJETS À PRENDRE EN CHARGE

 - Construire un moteur de gestion des sinistres à grande échelle : automatiser l’analyse des dossiers, les remboursements et les recouvrements, développer une capacité de détection de la fraude et piloter l’ensemble du parcours, du rapprochement avec les prestataires à la satisfaction des membres.

 - Industrialiser la gestion du réseau de prestataires : structurer le pilotage de plus de 1 200 établissements et 400 pharmacies, améliorer la fiabilité des paiements, suivre la qualité et développer le réseau dans de nouveaux territoires.

 - Déployer les opérations dans de nouveaux pays : construire un modèle opérationnel à partir de zéro, intégrer les exigences réglementaires locales, adapter le produit et mettre en place les partenariats nécessaires.

 - Maîtrise parfaite du français et un niveau d’anglais avancé.

 - Capacité à définir une vision et à la traduire en plan d’action concret, en intégrant les dimensions business, expérience client, réglementaire et financière.

 - Capacité à construire et optimiser des processus garantissant qualité, performance et évolutivité.

 - Goût pour la création de produits et services à partir de zéro, avec une approche centrée utilisateur et fondée sur les données.

 - Aisance dans les environnements très ambigus, sans mode opératoire préétabli.

 - Esprit pratique, rigueur et organisation, avec une capacité à entrer dans le détail.

 - Capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés : équipes locales, clients entreprises, professionnels de santé, régulateurs et siège Alan.


CE SERAIT UN PLUS

 - Expérience en assurance santé, mutuelle, structure IPM ou opérations de santé en Afrique de l’Ouest ou dans un autre marché émergent.

 - Connaissance de la zone réglementaire CIMA ou des marchés de l’assurance au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire.

 - Construire un cadre de suivi de la performance et identifier les principales pistes d’amélioration.

 - Contribuer au lancement des opérations d’Alan dans au moins un nouveau pays, en mettant en place les partenariats locaux et en adaptant notre modèle.

 - Participer au développement de l’équipe Operations, notamment au recrutement et à l’intégration de nouveaux membres.

title: Comptable
description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐️ LA FINANCE CHEZ ALAN ⭐️

La Finance chez Alan, c’est l’équipe qui bâtit le socle financier permettant de piloter une assurance santé digitale en pleine croissance, sur des marchés où presque tout reste à construire.

Le cœur de nos responsabilités : produire une information financière fiable pour chacune de nos entités, tenir des comptes toujours prêts pour la clôture, et donner à l’entreprise les chiffres sur lesquels elle peut s’appuyer pour décider. Au quotidien, cela signifie tenir la comptabilité, saisir un volume important d’opérations sans jamais rogner sur la qualité, piloter les clôtures et pousser l’automatisation pour aller toujours plus vite.

Nous réunissons une diversité de profils :

 - Des profils qui structurent : définition du modèle de reporting, des normes et des processus financiers,

 - Des profils qui délivrent : une production comptable et un reporting d’excellence au quotidien, tout en améliorant en continu ce que nous faisons.

Nous recherchons des membres d’équipe qui aiment que les comptes soient justes, à jour et bien tenus, et qui voient dans l’automatisation un moyen de faire mieux plutôt qu’une menace.




⭐️ LE RÔLE DE COMPTABLE ⭐️

Nous recherchons un(e) comptable rigoureux(se) et rapide pour tenir la comptabilité au quotidien de nos entités en Afrique de l’Ouest. C’est un poste à fort volume : de nombreuses opérations à saisir, à rapprocher et à classer chaque jour, avec une exigence de qualité constante.

Vous travaillerez sous la responsabilité du responsable financier et en lien avec les cabinets externes. En détail, vos missions comprendront :

 - Tenir la comptabilité au quotidien : saisir les achats, ventes, encaissements et décaissements, gérer un volume élevé d’opérations dans l’outil comptable (Sage, Odoo) en respectant le plan comptable SYSCOHADA.

 - Rapprocher et contrôler : réaliser les rapprochements bancaires et de trésorerie, lettrer les comptes tiers et suivre les comptes à régulariser pour que les livres restent propres.

 - Préparer les clôtures : participer aux clôtures mensuelles dans les délais et préparer les pièces et justificatifs demandés par le responsable financier et les cabinets externes.

 - Suivre les obligations courantes : contribuer à la préparation des déclarations (TVA notamment) et au suivi des paiements, en lien avec le cabinet d’expertise-comptable.

 - Automatiser et améliorer : repérer les tâches répétitives et proposer des façons de les simplifier — imports, modèles, automatisations — pour saisir plus vite et fiabiliser la donnée. C’est un vrai plus chez nous.

Vous ferez partie d’une petite équipe finance où votre régularité et votre sens du détail comptent énormément.




⭐️ UNE OPPORTUNITÉ UNIQUE DE PARTICIPER À QUELQUE CHOSE D'HISTORIQUE ⭐️

En tant que membre de l'équipe Alan, vous serez aux avant-postes d'une véritable révolution de la santé en Afrique de l'Ouest. Vous contribuerez à bâtir la colonne vertébrale opérationnelle d'une entreprise passant de 30 000 à des centaines de milliers de membres, de deux pays à un continent entier.

Vous vivrez l'énergie d'une startup rapide, portée par ses fondateurs et en pleine croissance. Ce n'est pas un poste d'opérations ordinaire : vous opérerez sur un marché où tout est à construire, et où votre travail aura un impact direct et visible sur la vie des gens.




⭐️ VOUS ÊTES PEUT-ÊTRE LA BONNE PERSONNE SI… ⭐️

 - Vous avez au moins 3 ans d’expérience en comptabilité, idéalement sur un poste à fort volume de saisie.

 - Vous maîtrisez le plan comptable SYSCOHADA / OHADA et les écritures courantes, ainsi qu’un logiciel comptable (Sage, Odoo ou équivalent).

 - Vous êtes rapide, rigoureux(se) et fiable : vous produisez du volume sans laisser passer d’erreurs.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise avec les tableurs (Excel / Google Sheets) et curieux(se) des outils qui font gagner du temps.

 - Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e) et respectueux(se) des délais.

 - Vous êtes à l’aise en français ; des notions d’anglais sont un plus.
   
   

C’est encore mieux si vous avez :

 - Une expérience en assurance santé, en mutuelle (IPM/mutuelle) ou en cabinet d’expertise-comptable.

 - Une appétence marquée pour l’automatisation : macros, scripts, imports, ou tout moyen de réduire la saisie manuelle.

 - Une expérience de la fiscalité locale (TVA) au Sénégal ou en Côte d’Ivoire.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI.

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.




🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES.

Si cette opportunité vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Toutes les personnes, y compris celles issues de groupes sous-représentés, devraient se sentir libres de postuler : soit on réussit, soit on apprend. Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. #LI-DNP

title: Corporate Paralegal
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


THE TEAM AND YOUR MISSIONS

As Alan’s Corporate Paralegal, you will be the operational backbone of the Corporate Governance Area, owning the processes that keep our corporate governance running smoothly across a fast-growing, expanding, international group, while building the AI processes that will allow Alan to scale sustainably. Currently, the Alan group spans across six jurisdictions, and a dozen entities, and those numbers are expected to grow quickly in the coming months.



You will run our core corporate governance and legal transactions with full ownership. You will support Alan’s Corporate Governance area on entity management, corporate secretarial matters, and cross-border corporate projects. There will also be opportunities to assist with M&A or fundraising transactions.

Example of tasks include:

 - Prepare corporate documentation for Boards and General Meetings, globally, coordinating with internal teams and auditors;

 - Keep governance documentation accurate and up to date across a growing international group;

 - Handle the annual accounts closing process across our entities and maintain up to date filings, corporate formalities and reporting with authorities or auditors;

 - Be the go-to contact for shareholder or Board questions;

 - Conduct legal research and drafting with the support of other Corporate Governance area members.
   
   

You will help improve the way our work is done, by creating the governance playbook as Alan keeps growing with improved documentation, workflows, and guidance. You will branch out of pure legal work and collaborate cross-functionally with other teams where needed (Finance, People…).

Example of tasks include:

 - Help establish and maintain governance processes as Alan opens entities;

 - Build playbooks and tools to support the governance of our international entities;

 - Adapt equity frameworks and documentation to new countries and local rules.
   
   

You will automate repeatable steps and contribute to the development of a more scalable corporate governance function. You will become one of our AI builders on legal corporate matters, turning tasks into smart automated systems while preserving human review, accountability and legal quality control.

Example of tasks include:

 - Enhance the team’s autonomy by building workflows that run in the background with light human maintenance, with the support of Alan's internal tooling team where needed, using no-code/low-code platforms and Alan's internal AI system;

 - Automate recurring corporate events such as equity movements  or meeting minutes.
   
   

You will work as part of the Corporate Governance Area, led by Anne-Lise Delfanne https://www.linkedin.com/in/anne-lise-d-4a454bb/, where legal and corporate operations experts collaborate closely to orchestrate governance operations and company-wide strategic initiatives.

At Alan, we embrace that roles evolve and expand beyond their initial scope. Your journey will be filled with opportunities to grow into broader projects.




KEY OUTCOMES AFTER SIX MONTHS

By the end of the first six months, successful onboarding would mean for you to have:

 - Gained deeper understanding of Alan’s governance mechanics, equity structures and regulatory context and taken ownership of recurring governance workflows for our French entities’ governance (to start with) confidently;

 - Trained yourself to build  AI agents and workflows that remove a meaningful chunk of manual work from you and the team;

 - Built or improved internal templates and documentation to strengthen the team’s knowledge;

 - Contributed to our international expansion by opening new local entities, supporting a new filing process, or onboarding local teams on our corporate governance processes.
   
   

From then onwards, the role will grow with you, as you prove ownership on the core governance scope, you will have the opportunity to take on more diverse projects (M&A, fundraising, reorganisations, etc.).




WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This role sits at the intersection of legal knowledge, corporate operations, and AI tooling. We don't expect anyone to arrive fully skilled across all three dimensions. What matters most is your ownership mindset and genuine appetite to build. For the rest, we'll grow together.

Experience: at least 3 years as a secretarial paralegal (corporate, M&A, finance), legal assistant at a reputable international law firm or in-house at a tier-1 scale-up with comparable exposure.

 - Legal knowledge: you have completed a law degree or equivalent paralegal qualification; you have a solid understanding of corporate governance mechanics;

 - AI and tooling appetite: strong appetite to learn or already comfortable with no-code/low-code platforms (e.g. Make, Zapier, Notion automations), workflows, AI tools, and structured data;

 - Language: excellent written and spoken English (working language at Alan) and French.

Behavioural traits

 - Highly organized and rigorous, with exceptional attention to details;

 - Hands-on and self-starter: not scared of getting your hands dirty;

 - Automatization mindset: sees repetitive work as an opportunity to build something better, not just a task to complete;

 - Intellectual curiosity: genuine appetite to learn and go beyond the initial scope.
   
   

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the B0-C0 level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

 

🔖 Check out our About Alan https://alan.com/about and Career https://alan.com/careers pages, as well as our Medium https://medium.com/alan, blog https://blog.alan.com/ and Glassdoor page https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Alan-EI_IE1696043.11,15.htm for more info.

 


YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT ALAN?

🙌 Perks & Benefits https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

🤘A strong culture https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work

⭐ YOUR MISSION

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers and we're looking for the next Sales engineer to join it.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

 - Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

 - Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

 - Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

 - Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

 - Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

 - Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

 - Participate to and eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings;

 - Work in close collaboration with your peers in France to insure good practice sharing and build a global playbook.

Your role will be to lead and coordinate Pre-sales strategy on the most complex deals. You will be at the driver seat, shaping and scaling this function, bringing both operational excellence and strategic vision within a recently created team and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most effective of all!

Do you want to get a glimpse of the team? ⬇️
Watch Lara's video to hear her testimonial.








⭐  OUR AMBITION IN BELGIUM ⭐

Since we opened our Belgium market in 2020, we have experienced great momentum and traction. We’ve onboarded 1200+ companies, and delighted 90.000+ members so far. Our local team is growing (so far we went from 0 to 70+ in just over 5 years 🚀).

We now want to take the market by storm and exponentially grow the business to ultimately become the market leader by 2030 in Belgium. Our pre-sales will ensure we continue to expand in the enterprise and public segments. Being at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate colleagues. We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!




⭐️ YOU WILL BE A GREAT FIT AT ALAN IF ⭐️

 - You have at least 4+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment;

 - Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English 

 - Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Dutch OR French

 - You are based in Belgium

 - You are experienced in end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

 - You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

 - You quickly get to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

 - You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

 - You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

 - You are great at sharing the right insights and context to influence the product we build;

 - You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

 - You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

 - You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

It would be even better if you have:

 - Being fluent in both Dutch AND French is a big plus

 - Experience in Insurance or Health platforms

 - Experience in end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s

 - Experience in HRIS / Payroll solutions

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🙌   PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ in Brussels, sponsored co-working hubs in Ghent or Antwerp or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your  time as you  wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. You can use your own inspiration based on the Green mobility budget (for Senior level Alaners)

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly  flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers and we're looking for the next Sales engineer to join it.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

 - Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

 - Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

 - Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

 - Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

 - Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

 - Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

 - Participate to and eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings;

 - Work in close collaboration with your peers in France to insure good practice sharing and build a global playbook.

You will be at the driver seat, shaping and scaling this function, bringing both operational excellence and strategic vision within a recently created team and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most effective of all!




⭐  OUR AMBITION IN BELGIUM ⭐

 - Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

 - Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

 - Flag risks and opportunities

 - Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

 - Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

 - Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

 - Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

 - Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

⭐️ OUR RUN ORGANISATION ⭐️

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


MISSION

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.


SCOPE


⚙️ PLATFORM & AUTOMATION

 - Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

 - Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

 - Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices


🔑 IDENTITY & ACCESS

 - Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

 - Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

 - Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

 - Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

 - Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack


🔒 ENDPOINT & SAAS SECURITY

 - Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

 - Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

 - Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope


🩺 HEALTH PROFESSIONALS IT

 - The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

 - Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process


🌍 INTERNATIONALISATION

 - Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

 - Bring acquired entities onto that same platform


MILESTONES

First 3 months

 - Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

 - Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

 - Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

 - Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

 - Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

 - Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

 - Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

 - Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

 - Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

 - Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

 - Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

 - Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

 - Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

 - Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

 - 4-5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

 - Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

 - You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

 - Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

 - Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

 - Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

 - Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

 - Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

 - Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

 - Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform

 - Kandji or another MDM at scale

 - Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

 - Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, HDS)

 - Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

 - Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

 - Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

⭐️ THE USER RESEARCHER ROLE ⭐️

At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. Our User Research team sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering, making sure every decision is grounded in what our members actually need, feel, and experience.

As a User Researcher at Alan, you will gather and prioritize the most important questions from across the company, and design the right research to answer them. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them.

You'll work hand in hand with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers, and collaborate closely with our analytics and data science teams to tell a complete story about our product. You'll also help grow research culture across Alan, sharing your craft and mentoring teammates along the way.

At Alan, great research drives great product. If you love figuring out what people truly need and translating that into decisions that matter, this role is for you.




⭐️ IF YOU HAVE SOME OF THE FOLLOWING, YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT ⭐️



You may be a great fit at Alan if you have:

 - 4+ years of experience as a product/user researcher in a tech environment, with strong hands-on expertise in qualitative methods: interviews, diary studies, think-aloud usability testing, and direct observation

 - Solid quantitative research skills: you're comfortable with survey design, sampling, crosstabs, and core statistical concepts

 - Sharp critical thinking: you quickly identify what research is worth doing, scope it efficiently, and deliver insights that are focused and actionable

 - A strategic mindset: you know how to partner with product stakeholders, communicate the value of research, and tie your findings to concrete business impact

 - Compelling communication skills: you turn complex findings into clear narratives that resonate with any audience

 - Experience mentoring junior researchers or non-researchers, with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback that helps others grow

 - You're close to AI. Either you've built AI products, or you follow the space closely and have a clear view on where to leverage and how LLM systems behave in production.

 - You care about healthcare. Alan's mission has to genuinely matter to you. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.

 - English fluency, written and spoken

 - (As a plus) Fluency in French, Spanish, or another European language

title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Sénégal 🇸🇳
description:
LA SANTÉ N'ATTEND PAS.

Que les symptômes s’aggravent. Qu'il faille 6 mois avant d’obtenir un rendez-vous. Qu'on dépende d’un système de santé englué dans le papier et les processus manuels. Et pourtant, c’est ainsi que fonctionne aujourd’hui la santé en Afrique de l’Ouest. Vous attendez, jusqu’à ne plus pouvoir attendre.

Nous existons pour mettre fin à cette attente.

Née en 2022 au Sénégal, Tanel est la première assurance santé numérique d’Afrique de l’Ouest francophone. Elle opère au Sénégal et en Côte d’Ivoire. Nous transformons un marché dominé par les processus papier et des acteurs historiques fragmentés. Avec plus de 30 000 membres, un réseau de plus de 1 200 établissements de santé et de plus de 400 pharmacies, ainsi qu’un chiffre d'affaires multiplié par 7 en 2025, nous avons démontré une véritable adéquation entre notre produit et les besoins du marché, dans des pays qui avaient besoin d’une révolution.

En 2026, Alan, le leader européen de l’assurance santé axée sur la prévention, avec plus de 950 M€ de CA et + 1 M de membres en France, en Belgique, en Espagne et au Canada, a acquis Tanel afin d’accélérer son expansion sur le continent africain. Ensemble, nous construisons l’assurance santé de référence en Afrique de l’Ouest francophone, avec l’ambition d’atteindre 200 M$ de CA d’ici 2030.

Nous réunissons le meilleur des deux mondes : l’expertise de terrain de Tanel, ses relations locales et la confiance qu’elle a su bâtir, ainsi que la plateforme technologique de pointe d’Alan, son expertise actuarielle et son expérience du déploiement dans plusieurs pays.




⭐ THE ENGINEERING TEAM ⭐

Au sein de notre équipe Engineering, nous construisons les infrastructures, les interfaces et les applications qui nous permettent d’offrir un service de premier ordre à nos membres, aux professionnels de santé et à nos propres équipes internes.

 - Être ingénieur(e) chez Alan, c’est rejoindre une équipe d’ingénieur(e)s talentueux(ses), engagé(e)s et passionné(e)s, avec une forte proximité avec le produit.

 - Nous avançons rapidement, avec un haut niveau d’autonomie, et sommes fiers de nous attaquer à des problèmes complexes.

 - Notre fonctionnement est très simple : les personnes qui prennent les décisions produit sont aussi celles qui construisent les solutions.

 - Notre stack technique repose notamment sur Python/Flask, React, React Native et PostgreSQL.

Vous souhaitez en savoir plus ? Consultez cet article https://blog.alan.com/tech-et-produit/engineering-organisation-at-alan pour découvrir le quotidien d’un(e) ingénieur(e) chez Alan, ainsi que cet article https://medium.com/alan/engineering-career-path-at-alan-e5de5c2e740c consacré à notre parcours de carrière Engineering.




⭐️ VOTRE MISSION: CONSTRUIRE LA CONVERGENCE ENTRE ALAN ET TANEL

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la convergence progressive des produits et des technologies d’Alan et de Tanel.

L’objectif sera de préserver le meilleur de chaque organisation : la connaissance fine du marché ouest-africain, l’expertise opérationnelle et les relations locales de Tanel, ainsi que la puissance de la plateforme, les pratiques produit et l’expérience internationale d’Alan.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

 - Faire converger les expériences produit et les fondations technologiques des deux entreprises.

 - Construire des composants et des systèmes réutilisables, capables de répondre aux besoins spécifiques des marchés locaux.

 - Faire évoluer nos outils afin d’accompagner la montée en charge du produit et des opérations.

 - Simplifier et automatiser les processus aujourd’hui gérés manuellement.

 - Améliorer la circulation et la fiabilité des données entre les équipes et les systèmes.

 - Trouver le bon équilibre entre standardisation globale et adaptation aux réalités du Sénégal et de la Côte d’Ivoire.

 - Préparer les fondations techniques nécessaires à notre expansion, à moyen terme, dans de nouveaux marchés d’Afrique de l’Ouest.

C’est une opportunité rare de travailler sur des problèmes complexes et concrets, avec un impact direct sur la manière dont la santé est financée, administrée et vécue par des milliers de personnes.

Est-ce vous que nous cherchons ?

Nous recherchons un(e) Software Engineer avec au moins trois ans d’expérience, capable de contribuer à des projets ambitieux dans un environnement en forte évolution.




VOUS SEREZ PARTICULIÈREMENT À VOTRE PLACE SI VOUS :

 - Êtes autorisé(e) à travailler au Sénégal, et êtes basé(e) à Dakar ou prêt(e) à vous y installer

 - Avez au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Software Engineer. On cherche à recruter à divers niveaux de séniorité, donc les profils seniors sont bienvenus !

 - Parlez français couramment

 - Avez un anglais avancé

 - Maîtrisez un langage de programmation, comme Python, Java, C# ou équivalent.

 - Êtes à l’aise avec les technologies web modernes et souhaitez travailler sur des applications fullstack.

 - Avez l’habitude de concevoir des systèmes robustes, maintenables et évolutifs.

 - Êtes intéressé(e) par les problématiques produit et aimez comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs.

 - Êtes autonome, pragmatique et capable de prendre des décisions.

 - Aimez travailler en équipe et collaborer avec des profils non techniques.

 - Êtes à l’aise dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.

 - Avez envie de contribuer à la construction d’une organisation technologique locale ambitieuse.

Une expérience dans l’assurance, la santé, les fintechs, les systèmes de paiement, les opérations ou les environnements réglementés serait un atout. Ce n’est toutefois pas une condition indispensable.

Nous recherchons avant tout des personnes curieuses, responsables et capables de progresser rapidement. Si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases mais que cette mission vous enthousiasme, nous aimerions tout de même recevoir votre candidature.




🎁 AVANTAGES

 - Type de contrat : CDI (avec 3 mois de période d’essai renouvelable une fois)

 - Sur site, dans nos bureaux de Dakar, en collaboration étroite avec une équipe locale passionnée.

 - Tous les outils nécessaires pour donner le meilleur de vous-même.

 - Une assurance santé complète via Alan pour vous et votre famille.

 - Des opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation : une politique RH flexible, des budgets pour les livres et les conférences.


🎯 NOTE IMPORTANTE : NOUS RECRUTONS DES PERSONNES, PAS DES RÔLES

Si cette opportunité vous intéresse mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions ravis d'échanger avec vous. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler !

Rappelez-vous, ceci est un guide, pas une liste exhaustive. Nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.
