title: Senior Engineering Manager (hands-on) - Work Environment
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐ BUILD THE AI-NATIVE COMPANY, FOR REAL

Alan has spent 10 years developing a distinctive way of working: radical transparency, written culture, distributed decision-making, no managers, no meetings by default. This wasn't just philosophy. It was a deliberate architectural choice, and it made Alan one of the most productive companies in European tech.

Now, agentic AI empowers us to make it much more personalized. The principles that made Alan productive become the foundation for a much more ambitious journey: a company where AI agents handle organizational complexity, surface the right context instantly, and let every person focus on the work that matters.

The Work Environment area builds that. Alaners are our users, and our internal platform is a Tier-1 product. The team is small and growing fast, and you'll lead its engineering.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

 - 🏠 Alan Home, the portal every Alaner opens first. The internal Operating System and the source of truth for who's who and who has access to what.

 - ⚙️ The rails the company runs on. Our automation platform, Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management, and user lifecycle automation across 25+ systems.

 - 🧱 Alan-native software instead of generic SaaS. Where a vendor forces Alan into someone else's way of working, we replace it, internalize and build our own. You'll hold the bar on which replacements earn their place, with a written case and a real ROI.

 - 🧑‍🚀 A growing team. You'll hire it, shape it, and decide what it works on. Talent density, onboarding, feedback, and the mix of skills the area needs are yours to own.

 - 🛡️ Technical direction and operational excellence. Architecture calls, quality standards, security practices, and incident response for systems that every single Alaner depends on. And you stay hands-on: at Alan, engineering leaders are expected to build.
   
   


⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth, engineers become better while building better products

 - Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

 - Your users sit next to you. Every Alaner uses what your team ships, every day. The feedback loop between building and impact is very short, which allows you to iterate and move quickly.
   
   


🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Leadership experience

 - 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

 - You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.

Technical foundations

 - Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

 - Experience with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools

 - Recent hands-on experience. You still review code, and you still write some.

What we value

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

 - You develop people as much as you develop products.

 - Fluent in English (French is a plus but not required).

Mission alignment:

 - Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

 - You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning
   
   


🌍 HOW WE WORK

Location: you must be legally eligible to work in France, Belgium, or Spain.

Hybrid approach: amazing office spaces, sponsored co-working hubs, or full remote. We want you where you're most effective at leading and developing your team.

Growth mindset: every Alaner gets a dedicated coach from day one. As a leader, you'll have additional support for developing your leadership skills.




🎯 IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


⭐️ THE KEY ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT TEAM


Our Account Management team’s purpose is to make our key accounts stay and grow with Alan. We created the team in 2020 and we are now 30+.
We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!



 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?


As a Key Account Manager, you will:

 - Handle a portfolio of strategic accounts in the Public Sector

 - Build and maintain strong customer relationships with key stakeholders and display a customer-centric approach to identify the main needs and allow our clients to achieve their goals through Alan

 - Proactively identify potential signals of dissatisfaction and implement solutions to answer them

 - Ensure successful onboarding of new accounts and promote Alan health partner positioning to generate massive adoption by employees and admins

 - Analyze and present consumption reports to customers through business reviews

 - Identify and execute out-of-the-box initiatives to engage our existing customers

 - Renegotiate contracts to guarantee both great value for money to our customers and sustainable profitability

 - Participate in the evolution of our products and services, acting as the voice of our customers when discussing with Product teams
   

You would be a great fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

 - You have at least 6 years of experience in a customer-facing role including frequent interactions with C-Levels

 - You have full working proficiency in French (excellent oral and written communication)

 - You have at least advanced level in English

 - You are experienced in dealing with very large organizations and potentially with unions 

 - You have the tact and empathy that make great negotiators

 - You are an expert in positive lobbying with key stakeholders and create long-term relationship based on trust and transparency

 - You are very analytical, very comfortable with presenting deep data analysis to clients and solving complex problems

 - You have great active listening skills and are a master in the art of crafting the right follow-up message

 - You have a growth mindset: you are able to adapt to new trends and to develop an in-depth understanding of the health insurance market

 - You are currently based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.


It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.


For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-E level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Bordeaux, Marseille or Annecy.

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.





 ⭐ WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE GENUINELY UNIQUE

 - You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

 - You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

 - You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

 - You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

 - Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.




⭐️ YOUR ROLE

Relationships & Presence

 - Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

 - Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

 - Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

 - Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise



Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

 - Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

 - Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

 - Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.



Sector Engagement & Anticipation

 - Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

 - Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

 - Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.



Build & Scale

 - Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

 - Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

 - Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

 - Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.



 ⭐ IS IT YOU WE’RE LOOKING FOR?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

 - Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

 - Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

 - Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

 - Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

 - Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

 - Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

 - Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

 - Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

 - Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.



Nice to have:

 - A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

 - Experience inside a paritariste institution

 - Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

title: Care Expert - Belgium (NL+EN) 🇧🇪
description:
GEZONDHEID KAN NIET WACHTEN.

Niet op symptomen die erger worden. Niet op een afspraak over zes maanden. Niet tot een systeem kan volgen. Maar zo werkt de zorg vandaag. Je wacht, totdat je niet meer kunt.
Alan bestaat om dat wachten te stoppen.
Gezondheid is een universeel recht, en we geloven dat dit recht pas echt wordt als het samengaat met preventie. We moeten stoppen met gezondheid te zien als iets dat we herstellen en beginnen met gezondheid elke dag op te bouwen. Het is niet alleen een kwestie van wilskracht. Het is het zorgsysteem zelf dat duurzaam voor iedereen moet werken.
Dus bouwen we aan de nieuwe norm in preventieverzekering. Alan is het eerste bedrijf dat verzekering, preventie en zorg integreert in één geprezen gebruikerservaring.
We zitten op een ongelooflijke reis om een wereldwijd toonaangevend bedrijf op te bouwen, met een unieke cultuur https://alan.com/en/careers. We werken al samen met meer dan 40 000 bedrijven van alle groottes, bedienen meer dan 1 000 000 leden en hebben € 800M+ aan ARR bereikt.
Preventie als de nieuwe norm. Dat bouwen we met ons team van meer dan 800 mensen. Spreekt het je aan: we werven aan in Frankrijk, Spanje, België en Canada. En daarbuiten.




⭐️ JOUW MISSIE ⭐️

Zorgen voor onze leden staat in het hart van ons werk. Onze User Care Experts staan in de frontlinie om leden te woord te staan (via chat, e-mail en telefoon), hun problemen op te lossen en een geweldige klantbeleving te bieden.

 - Helping our members — Je eerste taak is om de vragen van onze leden op een betekenisvolle, prettige en snelle manier af te handelen. Je doel is transparant, accuraat, duidelijk en behulpzaam te zijn. We hebben het tenslotte over iets cruciaals — hun gezondheid — en we zetten ons in voor uitzonderlijke service.

 - Improving Alan — Als User Care Expert krijg je naast het beantwoorden van ledenvragen ook de kans om aan projecten te werken. De focus van die projecten hangt af van je interesses en achtergrond. We verwachten dat je meehelpt betere processen en tools te implementeren en bijdraagt aan het verbeteren van ons product. Dat houdt in dat je analyseert wat je ziet, verbeterpunten identificeert en voorstellen doet.

 - Grow and learn — Bij Alan zijn we erop gebrand om zoveel mogelijk te leren. Het is niet elke dag dat je bij een snelgroeiend bedrijf kunt werken dat een verouderde sector uitdaagt door de lid centraal te zetten. Je wordt expert in zorg en verzekering, en helpt nieuwe collega’s in het zorgteam.

 - Pioneering — Het 🇧🇪 zorgteam is vandaag nog relatief klein. We hebben grote ambities en groeien snel. Je bent dagelijks betrokken bij het opbouwen, koesteren en verbeteren van ons zorgteam.




⭐️ SLUIT JE AAN BIJ HET 🇧🇪 ZORGTEAM ('CARE TEAM' = ZORGTEAM SOUNDS LIKE NURSES IN A HOSPITAL) ⭐️

Je past goed in deze rol als je:

 - Minstens 2 jaar ervaring hebt in klantenondersteuning, onderwijs of communicatie

 - Tweetalig bent: Engels + Nederlands ❗️

 - Een passie hebt om voor leden te zorgen en hun problemen op te lossen

 - Graag schriftelijk communiceert

 - Je goed voelt met computers en technologie

 - Een zeer empathische houding hebt

 - Gemotiveerd en ondernemend bent

 - Enthousiast bent over teamwork, leren en anderen begeleiden

Extra plus als je het Belgische gezondheidszorgsysteem kent — we leren het je als dat niet zo is. 😉

Alles wat je nog meebrengt is een plus. We willen dat ons team bestaat uit diverse ervaringen en achtergronden.
Goed om te weten:

 - Voor deze positie willen we iemand fulltime aannemen binnen de A1‑B1 loonschaal https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.

 - Het verzekeringsberoep is gereglementeerd en vereist dat alle medewerkers die met het publiek in contact komen binnen hun eerste werkjaar een basisexamen verzekeringskennis afleggen (sommige vrijstellingen mogelijk). Dit examen wordt door Alan betaald; contacteer ons voor meer info!

Benieuwd naar het team? Bekijk dan de video van Elouiza!







🌍 HOE WE WERKEN

 - Locatie: Je moet wettelijk bevoegd zijn om in België of Frankrijk te werken.

 - Thuiswerk: We bieden flexibiliteit voor thuiswerk, maar we hechten waarde aan samenwerken op kantoor.




🎯 BELANGRIJK: WE ZOEKEN MENSEN, GEEN ROLLEN.

Als je enthousiast bent over deze kans maar niet aan elk vakje voldoet, horen we toch graag van je. Iedereen, hoe ondervertegenwoordigd ook, moet zich vrij voelen om te solliciteren — dat brengt alleen maar inzichten of succes.
Als je jezelf als vrouw identificeert: wist je dat onderzoek toont dat vrouwen vaak alleen solliciteren als ze aan 100% van de vereisten voldoen?
Onthoud: dit is een gids, geen checklist. We kijken ernaar uit je sollicitatie te ontvangen!

Wil je meer weten over Alan?

🙌 Voordelen & extra’s https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity: Alaners krijgen een stimulerende werkomgeving en voordelen zodat ze gelukkig en efficiënt zijn en hun tijd met collega’s van hoge kwaliteit doorbrengen.

🤘 Een sterke cultuur https://alan.com/en/about/a/leadership-principles: Mensen die bij Alan komen, zijn vaak verrast en blij met onze innovatieve manier van werken. We hebben een set culturele waarden die onze aanpak richting geven.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

 - Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

 - Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

 - People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

 - Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.



👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

 - At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

 - Previous experience in a fast-scaling company, start-up or scale-up, ideally having helped build or scale People processes during a period of significant growth.

 - Business curiosity: genuinely interested in what's happening on the business side, and able to connect your work to where the company is heading

 - Versatility across People and Corporate/Admin topics, with a strong People focus

 - Rigour and rock-solid attention to detail

 - Autonomy: you don't wait to be told there's a problem — you spot it, bring a solution, and know when to loop someone in on the tricky ones

 - Demonstrated interest in automating and improving recurring processes, and genuine enthusiasm for AI

 - Comfort interacting with a wide range of stakeholders, including senior profiles when needed

 - Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

 - Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

 - Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

 - Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

🛠️ THE STACK

Python/Flask, Typescript, React, React Native on the coding side. AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Redis, Terraform/Terramate, Datadog, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions on the platform side, all in a monorepo. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership - you build it, you own it.




🤖 THE DATA FOUNDATIONS CREW - WITHIN THE TECH FOUNDATIONS AREA




🎯 MISSION

 - Tech Foundations - enables product crews and creates the environment to thrive, combining world-class infrastructure, intuitive developer experience, exquisite operational excellence, and built-in security to make shipping exceptional products effortless.

 - Data Foundations - is one of its crews. Its mission: be the enabling and platform team for data lifecycle and privacy engineering across Alan: retention, deletion, anonymization, and pseudonymization, by design. It builds and runs the GDPR Orchestrator (the platform's current embodiment) and equips each area to own its own data rules on top of it. The team also handles data shared with third parties and partners, with Legal and Security on requirements, including authority-facing work (e.g. CNIL).


🔭 SCOPE

 1. Own and evolve the privacy platform (build & run): its core engine, its safety mechanisms (preview/dry-run, audit trail), and its operational health (deploys, on-call, observability). You design the contract areas build on and keep it reliable as adoption grows.

 2. Build the paved road (enable, teach to fish): docs, templates, and self-serve tooling so any of our 15+ areas can plug into the platform and manage its own data rules and dependencies. You coach areas through pairing and syncs; you build the capability rather than doing the work for them.

 3. Coordinate across areas (the cross-area bridge): align legal, security, data, and the data-producing areas on requirements, surface cross-area data dependencies, and resolve design trade-offs between them. You own the coordination; each area stays accountable for its own data and rules.

 4. Push the foundations forward: drive open platform design questions to a conclusion and grow the platform's capabilities as Alan's data, products, and footprint expand.
    
    


👀 FOCUS FOR 2026

 - Own the platform: become the long-term owner of the GDPR Orchestrator and shape the roadmap for how Alan manages data lifecycle at scale.

 - Raise the bar on the platform: invest in its safety, observability, and developer experience so areas build on it with confidence.

 - Lay the paved road: ship the docs, templates, and tooling that let areas self-serve, then move ownership of data rules to the areas that produce the data.

 - Scale the surface: grow the platform's reach across data stores and third-party systems as Alan expands into new countries.
   
   


⭐ IS IT YOU WE'RE LOOKING FOR?




EXPERIENCE WE VALUE

 - Senior-level experience (typically 8+ years) in backend or platform software engineering, or equivalent, with deep production ownership (API and contract design, data modeling, running what you ship).

 - You've built and operated platforms, libraries, or services that other engineers depend on, and you care about the contract you expose to them.

 - You're comfortable operating across many teams and influencing without authoritarianism: getting legal, security, data, and product crews who don't report to you aligned on a plan, and driving it to completion.

 - You bring pragmatism under constraint: you ship sound, safe solutions and improve them over time, rather than waiting for perfect.

 - Strong plus: prior privacy, GDPR, or data-governance exposure, and experience working in an enabling or platform-team operating model.

 - Explicitly not required: deep legal expertise. Legal and security partner with this role; they don't get replaced by it.
   
   


MINDSET WE VALUE

 - You treat platform engineering as product work: engineers and members are your customers, and doing the right thing with their data should feel effortless.

 - You're hands-on: writing code is the bulk of the job (Python, TypeScript). You ship what you write to production yourself, then operate it: rollouts, alerting, on-call, incident response.

 - You design and communicate: you're as comfortable writing a framing doc, drawing a dependency map, and aligning several areas on a design decision as you are writing the code.

 - You're an enabler: you measure your impact by how fast areas run their own data rules without ever consulting you. The harder you've worked, the less they have to engage you.

 - You build reusable patterns: guardrails, libraries, and safe-by-default abstractions that keep data handling correct and safe by design at scale.

 - You're fluent in English (French is not required).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire above the E level range https://medium.com/alan/a-new-iteration-of-our-engineering-career-path-at-alan-f46f7b229b2d.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🚀 WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

We're building a medical experience that works reliably, safely, and at scale. An AI agent, and the clinic behind it. You'll lead the engineering team and you'll keep building alongside them.

 - 💬 The team behind the most memorable chatting experience. Hiring, onboarding, honest feedback, and the mix of skills Mo needs as it grows. Talent density is yours to own.

 - ➕ The architecture for Mo's next chapters. More context, new skills, new countries. You guide the calls on our architecture and agentic framework, and you stay close enough to the code to make them well.

 - 🏥 The platform that turns conversations into care. Chat with health practitioners, teleconsultation at national scale, and the tooling doctors and therapists use every day. You drive alignment with the crews and medical teams on the other side, so members get from words to actions.

 - 🛡️ Operational excellence. Mo and teleconsultation are real-time services that have to be live 24/7. Latency, error rates, incident response, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out.

If you're excited by the idea of building the future of healthcare, this is the team for you. We're at the start of the journey. If you're curious, here https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12808 is a paper we published recently.



⚡ WHY THIS ROLE IS SPECIAL

 - Dual impact: Shape both technical excellence and team growth - your engineers become better while building better products

 - Leadership growth: Influence engineering culture, mentor future leaders, and drive technical strategy that shapes the future of healthcare delivery

 - Startup speed, Alan's platform. Mo operates with the focus of a startup, on top of Alan's infrastructure, distribution, and health expertise. Small team, huge reach.

 - Stakes that make the work matter. In medical AI, reliability and safety are the product. Every call you make on quality, architecture, and evaluation is a call about our members' health.


🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an engineering leader who gets excited about building state-of-the-art AI systems and applying them to real-world, high-stakes problems in healthcare.




LEADERSHIP EXPERIENCE

 - 3+ years leading engineering teams, with a track record of building high performers.

 - You partner with other product functions as a true equal: you shape the roadmap, name trade-offs honestly, and help the team commit to what it can actually deliver.


TECHNICAL FOUNDATIONS

 - Experience establishing engineering excellence standards, with the ability to guide architectural decisions.

 - First-hand experience shipping AI or LLM products to production is a big plus.

 - You're excited and eager to keep writing code. You still review it, and you still ship some yourself.

 - Comfortable with modern development practices and AI-assisted development tools.


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curious, self-starting, humble, collaborative, and eager to grow.

 - You develop people as much as you develop products.

 - Ex-founders are typically a great fit in our team.


MISSION ALIGNMENT

 - Healthcare technology and innovation excite you

 - You understand that great engineering teams are built on psychological safety and continuous learning

title: Sales Planning & Strategy
description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


🧩 CONTEXT OF THE ROLE

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

 - Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

 - Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

 - Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).




🎯 YOUR MISSION

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

 - Business Strategy
   
   - Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan
   
   - Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)
   
   - Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

 - Sales & Account Manager Planning
   
   - Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy
   
   - Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

 - Performance monitoring & Steering
   
   - Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions
   
   - Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis
   
   - Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)
     
     


🧐 SKILLS WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.



At least 3 years of experience within either:

 - Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

 - Management consulting, investment banking or private equity
   
   

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

 - Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

 - Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

 - Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

 - Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company
   
   

Business sense:

 - At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

 - Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones
   
   

Communication and presence:

 - Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

 - Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

 - Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

 - Great written and oral structure and communication

 - Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

 - Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area or Barcelona
   
   

Nice to have

 - Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

 - Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

 - Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range https://alan.com/en/careers/a/salary-equity.




🙌 PERKS & BENEFITS https://alan.com/about/life-at-alan/a/perks

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

 - Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

 - Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

 - Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture https://alan.com/en/blog/discover-alan/a/alan-culture-excellence-through-coaching.

 - Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.
   
   


IMPORTANT NOTE: WE HIRE PEOPLE, NOT ROLES.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Digital Marketing & Business Analyst
description:
Digital Virgo is a global leader in mobile payments and digital services, connecting merchants, operators, and consumers through innovative monetization solutions.
Operating in more than 40 countries, we help our partners grow their digital business by delivering high-performing subscription services, digital entertainment, payment solutions, and customer acquisition strategies.
As part of our expansion in Saudi Arabia, we are looking for a Digital Marketing & Business Analyst to support the growth of our digital services by combining business analysis, marketing coordination, and operational project management.

Main Responsibilities
Business Performance & Analytics
• Monitor the performance of Digital Virgo's digital services through key business and marketing KPIs (traffic, conversion, subscriptions, revenue, churn, customer acquisition, retention, ROI, etc.).
• Analyze business performance and identify optimization opportunities to improve profitability.
• Conduct competitive analysis, benchmark market trends, and identify new growth opportunities within the Saudi digital ecosystem.
• Produce structured weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations.
• Support forecasting activities and monitor business performance against objectives.
Digital Marketing
• Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns across acquisition channels.
• Monitor campaign performance and recommend optimization actions based on data analysis.
• Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Business Development, and Operations teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with business objectives.
• Contribute creative ideas to improve customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.
• Assist in developing localized marketing materials and messaging adapted to the Saudi market.
Business Operations & Project Coordination
• Coordinate the launch of new digital services and marketing initiatives.
• Follow project timelines and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.
• Coordinate with Product, Technical, Marketing, Business Development, Operations, Customer Care, and external partners.
• Monitor operational performance and proactively identify issues affecting business results.
• Participate in service testing, launch preparation, and post-launch monitoring.
Stakeholder Management
• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Ensure effective communication across all teams involved in project delivery.
• Prepare presentations and business reports for management.
• Support cross-functional collaboration to ensure smooth execution of strategic initiatives.

Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
• 2–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Business Analysis, Product Marketing, Digital Services, Telecom, Mobile Payments, VAS, FinTech, or a similar digital environment.
• Experience in the Saudi market is a strong advantage.
Required Skills
Business & Analytics
• Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret business data and transform it into actionable recommendations.
• Comfortable working with KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting.
• Advanced Excel skills; experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools is an advantage.
Marketing
• Good understanding of digital marketing channels and customer acquisition.
• Knowledge of subscription-based digital services is a plus.
• Ability to analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.
Project Management
• Strong organizational and coordination skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience using Jira or similar project management tools.
Communication
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work effectively with multicultural and cross-functional teams.
• Strong presentation skills.
Languages
• Fluent English and Arabic (spoken and written) are mandatory.
• French is a plus.
Preferred Experience
Experience in one or more of the following industries would be highly appreciated:
• Mobile Payments
• Telecom
• Value-Added Services (VAS)
• Digital Content
• Digital Advertising
• FinTech
• Subscription-based Digital Services

title: Finance & Accounting Assistant
description:
Digital Virgo is a global leader in mobile payments and digital services, connecting merchants, operators, and consumers through innovative monetization solutions.
Operating in more than 40 countries, we help our partners grow their digital business by delivering high-performing subscription services, digital entertainment, payment solutions, and customer acquisition strategies.

The Finance & Accounting Assistant supports the day-to-day financial, accounting and administrative activities of Digital Virgo Tunisia.
Working closely with the Finance and Administration Manager, the successful candidate will contribute to the effective management of treasury operations, supplier payments, purchasing controls, collection of customer receivables related to the DV Contact activity, and general administrative follow-up.
The Finance & Accounting Assistant will also help ensure the accuracy and reliability of financial and accounting information by monitoring accounts, performing bank reconciliations and preparing supporting documentation, in close coordination with the Chief Accountant & HR and the relevant internal teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Treasury Management
• Prepare and submit weekly and monthly cash-flow reports.
• Manage the company’s day-to-day cash receipts and expenses.
• Alert the Chief Financial Officer to any liquidity risks or significant discrepancies.
• Ensure the administrative follow-up of banking transactions.
2. Supplier Payments and Purchasing Controls
• Prepare supplier payments.
• Verify the compliance and completeness of supporting documents and required approvals.
• Monitor and perform the financial validation of purchasing transactions.
3. Customer Receivables – DV Contact Activity
• Monitor outstanding customer receivables.
• Regularly update the customer receivables tracking report.
• Coordinate payment reminders with the relevant operational teams.
• Identify overdue or potentially high-risk receivables.
4. General Administration
• Monitor the company’s main administrative services and related activities.
• Manage day-to-day relationships with insurance companies and administrative service providers.
• Coordinate matters relating to meal vouchers and group insurance plans.
5. General Accounting
• Perform account reconciliation and monitoring.
• Complete bank reconciliations.
• Prepare account supporting and justification files.
• Assist with month-end closing activities and the preparation of financial documentation when required.

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
• Eligible for an SIVP contract in Tunisia.
• A first internship or initial experience in accounting, finance, treasury or administration would be an advantage.
• Good understanding of general accounting principles and financial processes.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard office applications.
• Knowledge of accounting software or an ERP system would be an advantage.
• Good command of French; professional working knowledge of English would be appreciated.
• Strong organizational and analytical skills, with close attention to detail.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
• Proactive, reliable and able to work effectively with different internal and external stakeholders.
• Fluency in Arabic and French is required, and a good command of English is highly desirable.

title: Finance Manager / Senior Accountant (M/F/D)
description:
About Digital Virgo
🌍 Digital Virgo Group is one of the world’s leading specialists in mobile payment solutions through telecom operator billing. By connecting merchants with telecom operators, the Group addresses the growing need for digital payment solutions through a simple, fast and secure transactional channel available worldwide.
Our teams combine an entrepreneurial mindset with the resources and international reach of a global Group. We value autonomy, initiative and collaboration.
More information: digitalvirgo.com
 Alchimie GmbH is a wholly owned subsidiary of Digital Virgo Group. Based in Düsseldorf, our company provides content distribution, media aggregation and streaming services in partnership with German telecom operators.

The role
As part of the planned retirement of our current accountant, we are looking for a Finance Manager / Senior Accountant to take ownership of the finance and accounting activities of our German operations.
Reporting directly to the local CEO, you will be the stand-alone finance professional for two small German legal entities, while working closely with Digital Virgo’s Group Finance teams.
This is a hands-on position: you will manage day-to-day accounting yourself, ensure monthly and year-end closings, oversee local tax compliance and contribute to financial analysis and Group reporting.
You will also play a key role in the upcoming migration to the Group ERP, Workday.
A transition period with the current accountant will be organised before his retirement in early 2027.

Your main responsibilities
• Manage day-to-day accounting: general ledger, AP/AR, bank accounting and customer invoicing.
• Own the monthly closing process, including accruals, provisions, reconciliations and other closing entries.
• Prepare the accounts and supporting documentation for the annual statutory closing.
• Manage recurring tax compliance, including VAT declarations, with support from external tax advisers when needed.
• Prepare financial information and reporting for Digital Virgo Group and manage intercompany accounting.
• Ensure appropriate accounting of Group profit-sharing arrangements and compliance with transfer-pricing policies.
• Analyse revenue, costs and margins, investigate variances and identify errors or improvement opportunities.
• Support budgeting, forecasting and ad-hoc financial analysis.
• Act as the local Finance key contact for the Workday implementation, from process mapping and data preparation through testing and go-live.

You are a hands-on, experienced accounting professional who can independently manage the accounts of small German entities through monthly and year-end closing.
What we are looking for:
• 5+ years of relevant accounting experience, ideally in a German SME, German subsidiary of an international group, or accounting/tax advisory firm.
• Strong practical knowledge of German accounting (HGB) and experience preparing monthly and year-end closings, including accruals, provisions and balance-sheet reconciliations.
• Practical knowledge of German VAT and recurring tax compliance; you do not need to be a tax expert, as external advisers can provide support on complex or one-off matters.
• Ability and willingness to manage day-to-day bookkeeping yourself. This is a stand-alone Finance position with no accounting team reporting to you.
• Good understanding of P&L and margin analysis, with the ability to investigate variances and identify accounting errors or business improvement opportunities.
• Comfortable working with ERP and finance systems and strong Excel skills. Experience with Workday or an ERP implementation/migration is a plus.
• Fluent German and good professional English, enabling you to work directly with Digital Virgo's international Finance teams.
• Autonomous, rigorous and pragmatic, with the confidence to raise issues and interact directly with the local CEO and Group Finance.

What we offer
A broad and autonomous Finance role within a small local organisation, combined with the exposure and projects of an international Group.
You will join at an important time for our German operations, with a second legal entity being established and the upcoming Workday implementation.
Compensation: €55,000–€65,000 gross/year, depending on experience.

Remote working : TBD (hybrid mode)

Location: Düsseldorf, Germany.

title: Technical Project Manager - Maroc
description:
Digital Virgo est un acteur mondial spécialisé dans le paiement mobile et la monétisation via la facturation opérateur (Direct Carrier Billing – DCB). Présent dans plus de 40 pays, le groupe collabore avec des opérateurs télécoms et des marchands pour déployer des services digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée. Les Technical Project Managers jouent un rôle clé dans la réussite des projets en alignant les objectifs business avec l’exécution technique.

Présentation du poste
Le Technical Project Manager pilotera les intégrations locales et régionales avec les opérateurs télécoms et les marchands. Il sera responsable de la validation des flows et des APIs, de la coordination des setups techniques, du suivi des tests et de la production de la documentation opérationnelle. Le poste nécessite une forte autonomie, une bonne communication et la capacité à interagir efficacement avec des partenaires techniques et business.
Missions principales
• Valider la disponibilité et la complétude des flows et des endpoints APIs (charging, cancellation, invoice, etc.).
• Rédiger, maintenir et partager une documentation technique claire, incluant les starter kits et les diagrammes de flows.
• Coordonner la mise en place des environnements techniques (VPN, IP whitelisting, SMPP, accès sandbox, etc.).
• Préparer et suivre l’exécution des testbooks avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.
• Valider les tests techniques et fonctionnels avant passage aux étapes suivantes du projet.
• Participer au debugging et identifier les écarts techniques lors des intégrations.
• S’assurer que la documentation est centralisée et régulièrement mise à jour dans Jira, SharePoint ou les outils internes prévus.
• Suivre l’avancement des projets et communiquer clairement les blocages aux équipes internes et externes.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes DV (Business, équipes techniques, Produit, QA, etc.) et les partenaires locaux ou régionaux.
• Accompagner les équipes Produit lors des phases de tests, lancement et stabilisation post-lancement.

Profil recherché
• Minimum 5 ans d’expérience, incluant au moins 2 ans d’exposition au développement ou à l’intégration d’APIs, ainsi qu’une expérience significative en gestion de projet.
• Bonne maîtrise du testing et du debugging d’APIs (Postman, Swagger, logs, REST, JSON).
• Capacité à lire, comprendre et challenger une documentation technique.
• Bonne maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet (MS Project, Jira, Excel).
• Très bon niveau de communication en français et en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
• Connaissance des environnements télécoms : SMS/USSD, DCB, SMPP, OTP, un plus.
• Capacité à prendre contact directement avec les partenaires (appels, réunions, déplacements si nécessaire) pour débloquer les sujets.
• Bonne compréhension des contextes multiculturels et capacité à interagir avec des interlocuteurs locaux et internationaux.
Soft Skills
• Autonome, structuré et fiable sous pression.
• Bonne capacité de communication dans des contextes multi-intervenants.
• Capacité à relancer, escalader et recadrer les priorités lorsque nécessaire.
• Esprit analytique et orienté résolution de problèmes.
• Capacité à proposer des alternatives ou des workarounds techniques.
• Facilité d’adaptation à des environnements multiculturels.
• Ouverture à des déplacements ponctuels lorsque la présence physique est nécessaire pour le projet.

title: IT TECHNICAL PROJECT MANAGER
description:
Digital Virgo is a global leader in mobile payment and monetization through direct carrier billing (DCB).
We operate in over 40 countries and partner with telecom operators and merchants to deploy high-impact payment and content services.
Our Technical Project Managers ensure local project success by aligning business objectives with technical execution

The Technical Project Manager will lead local and regional integrations with telecom operators and merchants. He will be responsible for validating flows and APIs, coordinating technical setups, ensuring test coverage, and delivering operational documentation. The role requires strong communication and autonomy to operate effectively with partners, including the ability to build local trust, overcome cultural barriers, and intervene physically or by phone when necessary to resolve issues.

Key Responsibilities
• Validate availability and completeness of flows and API endpoints (charging, cancellation, invoice, etc.)
• Draft, maintain and share clear technical documentation including starter kits and flow diagrams
• Coordinate local environment setup (VPN, IP whitelisting, SMPP…)
• Prepare and follow execution of testbooks with internal teams and external partners
• Validate technical & functional tests
• Support debugging and identify technical gaps during integration
• Ensure documentation is centralized and regularly updated in Jira, Sharepoint…
• Track progress and communicate blockers clearly with internal and external teams
• Work closely with DV teams (Business, Technical teams, Product…) and local partners
• Support Product team on product launch testing and debugging
Required Profile
• Minimum 5 years of experience in technical missions (development, network, telecom) and then in Project Management
• Familiar with API testing and debugging (Postman, Swagger, logs, REST, JSON)
• Ability to read and interpret technical documentation
• Familiarity with project tools (MS Project, Jira, Excel)
• Proficient in English (spoken and written); French is a plus
• Knowledge of telecom environments: SMS/USSD flows, DCB, SMPP, OTP is a plus
• Comfortable making direct contact with partners (calls, onsite if needed) to resolve blocking points
• Understanding of regional context and ability to interact with local stakeholders effectively
Soft Skills
• Autonomous, structured and dependable under pressure
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder contexts
• Capable of escalating and pushing for priorities when needed
• Problem-solving mindset and ability to propose viable workarounds
• Culturally aware, able to adapt to local environments and build trust quickly
• Open to occasional travel when project delivery requires physical presence

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Digital Virgo is a global leader in mobile payment and monetization through direct carrier billing (DCB). We operate in over 40 countries and partner with telecom operators and merchants to deploy high-impact payment and content services. Our Technical Project Managers ensure local project success by aligning business objectives with technical execution.

The Technical Project Manager will lead local and regional integrations with telecom operators and merchants. He will be responsible for validating flows and APIs, coordinating technical setups, ensuring test coverage, and delivering operational documentation. The role requires strong communication and autonomy to operate effectively with partners, including the ability to build local trust, overcome cultural barriers, and intervene physically or by phone when necessary to resolve issues.

Key Responsibilities
• Validate availability and completeness of flows and API endpoints (charging, cancellation, invoice, etc.)
• Draft, maintain and share clear technical documentation including starter kits and flow diagrams
• Coordinate local environment setup (VPN, IP whitelisting, SMPP…)
• Prepare and follow execution of testbooks with internal teams and external partners
• Validate technical & functional tests
• Support debugging and identify technical gaps during integration
• Ensure documentation is centralized and regularly updated in Jira, Sharepoint…
• Track progress and communicate blockers clearly with internal and external teams
• Work closely with DV teams (Business, Technical teams, Product…) and local partners
• Support Product team on product launch testing and debugging
Required Profile
• Minimum 5 years of experience in technical missions (development, network, telecom) and then in Project Management
• Familiar with API testing and debugging (Postman, Swagger, logs, REST, JSON)
• Ability to read and interpret technical documentation
• Familiarity with project tools (MS Project, Jira, Excel)
• Proficient in English (spoken and written); French is a plus
• Knowledge of telecom environments: SMS/USSD flows, DCB, SMPP, OTP is a plus
• Comfortable making direct contact with partners (calls, onsite if needed) to resolve blocking points
• Understanding of regional context and ability to interact with local stakeholders effectively
Soft Skills
• Autonomous, structured and dependable under pressure
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder contexts
• Capable of escalating and pushing for priorities when needed
• Problem-solving mindset and ability to propose viable workarounds
• Culturally aware, able to adapt to local environments and build trust quickly
• Open to occasional travel when project delivery requires physical presence

title: Conseiller de vente Paris (H/F)

Il/elle participe à la production d’analyses, à la coordination des équipes et à la mise en place de templates et de reporting standardisés.

Responsabilités principales :

1. Analytique et Reporting :

o Fabriquer des analyses ad hoc et régulières pour les équipes de Paris et Marseille.
o Créer et maintenir des dashboards et reporting standardisés pour faciliter la lecture et la prise de décision.
o Produire et suivre les budgets, les licences, les charges CAPEX/OPEX et différents calculs analytiques selon les besoins du département.

o Travaillez en liens avec la BI back qui réalise l'extraction des données,
o Êtes en charge de la restitution des données au département Conseil,
o Réalisez les tableaux de bord Power BI afin de fournir des reportings en adéquation avec les besoins,
o Assurez la qualité, la cohérence et la sécurité des données,
o Intégrez et modélisez des sources de données multiples.

2. Coordination et Back Office :

o Gérer la logistique des projets analytiques : suivi des commandes, relances auprès des équipes, gestion des micro-tâches.
o Assurer le suivi administratif (devis, factures, bon de commande).
o Coordonner les informations entre les équipes de Paris et Marseille pour garantir la cohérence et la standardisation des process.
o Organisez le delivery sur votre périmètre.

3. Communication :

o Communiquer efficacement avec les consultants, chefs de projet et autres parties prenantes.
o S’assurer que les informations et analyses sont transmises clairement et dans les délais.
o Formez les utilisateurs sur site ou à distance,
o Produisez des supports de formation (documentation technique et vidéo) pour apprivoiser les rapports produits,
o Assurez une veille technologique sur les outils BI,
o Résolvez les problèmes techniques liés à Power BI,
o Fédérez les utilisateurs autour de la restitution de la data.

• Compétences analytiques solides et rigueur dans le traitement des données.
• Maîtrise d’outils BI et Excel avancé ; maîtrise de Power BI.
• Capacité à coordonner et relancer des équipes, sens de l’organisation et gestion des priorités.
• Bonnes compétences de communication écrite et orale.
• Sens du détail et autonomie dans le suivi des tâches répétitives ou logistiques.

Expérience :

title: Développeur senior Java back-end
description:
Résumé de l'annonce en 5 points 🎯

• Profil recherché avec 10 années d’expérience min - Salaire de 50 à 55K €

• Instant System est un éditeur qui développe des applis web et mobile de mobilité urbaine.

• 12 ans d'existence et 125 personnes dans nos locaux de Sophia-Antipolis.

• Application utile à la société et qui œuvre pour l'environnement !

• Stack : Java 11 -> 21, Springboot 2.3 -> 3.2, JPA, Hibernate, Microservices, MapStruct, Lombok, OpenAPI, MySQL, Redis, Sonar, Git, Bitbucket, Maven, IntelliJ, Rabbit MQ, Kafka, architecture multi-tenant, ...

Que faisons-nous et qui sommes-nous ?

La mobilité et les transports sont la 1ère source de pollution dans le monde. Instant System développe des applications pour faire changer les habitudes, être plus vertueux 🌱 et mieux vivre ensemble.
Concrètement, nos applications web et mobiles guident les voyageurs en ville.
Bus, train, trottinette, vélo électrique, co-voiturage et bien d’autres : nous mixons toutes les possibilités dans une solution unifiée pour nos usagers.

Créé il y a 12 ans, nous embarquons aujourd’hui 125 personnes. Notre siège social et notre centre R&D se trouvent à Sophia-Antipolis. Tu rejoins donc un vrai éditeur de logiciels, pas la petite startup créée il y 6 mois 😉

Nous fonctionnons aujourd’hui en marque blanche avec les collectivités publiques comme les villes, les Métropoles et les Régions.
Avec plus de 15 millions d’utilisateurs réguliers, tu as sûrement déjà vu ou utilisé nos solutions : Navigo à Paris, Zou! pour la région PACA ou Envibus avec la Communauté d’Agglomération de Sophia-Antipolis.

Nos objectifs pour l'avenir sont ambitieux et réalisables 🚀 : continuer le développement à l’international et en France. Sans oublier le lancement de notre offre SaaS 100% paramétrable et notre nouvelle solution dédiée aux entreprises et à la mobilité de leurs employés.

Comment est l’ambiance chez nous ?

L’ambiance est studieuse et on apprécie également se retrouver ensemble : barbecue sur la terrasse, petit déjeuner royal, raclettes party, team building (été ET hiver) et soirée à thème ou musical.
Pour les sportifs, une coach est présent 2 fois par semaine pour des séances de crossfit.
Tu pourras également profiter d’une salle de musique 🎸, de 2 terrasses et d’une cafet’ avec babyfoot, boissons caféinées/chocolatées et fruits en libre accès (livraison 3 fois par semaine).
Nous sommes installés dans de nouveaux locaux, spacieux et lumineux, bien desservis par les transports.
Attention, nous ne sommes pas une grosse structure avec des process et règles strictes. Tout n’est pas parfait et tu rejoins une société vivante qui continue de s’améliorer, de s’organiser et où tu pourras apporter ta pierre à l'édifice !
Peut-être en as-tu déjà discuté avec des amis, nous sommes reconnus sur Sophia-Antipolis pour avoir des équipes et des technos à la page 💻 (cf. stack technique plus bas). Tu le verras, nos produits sont très complexes techniquement et fonctionnellement.

Bref, tu ne vas pas t’ennuyer !

Que vas-tu faire et dans quel contexte ?

Tu rejoindras notre département technique de 80+ personnes. Nos projets sont gérés selon un mode Agile que nous avons adapté à notre fonctionnement sur des cycles de 2 semaines. Et cela fait maintenant quelques mois que l’on s’est lancé avec SAFe. Tu le verras par toi-même, les PI Planning sont particulièrement animés !
Nous fonctionnons en petites équipes travaillant, soit sur des projets polyvalents pour un client, soit sur une ligne de produit spécifique : transport, vente, SaaS, R&D, … Ce sont des squads d’une 10aine de personnes composées de développeurs mobile natif, web, back-end, tech lead/architecte, QA,, Business Analyst, DevOps, Delivery Manager.

Tu auras la chance de travailler de beaux projets avec du SaaS et du cloud !

Ton quotidien sera varié :

• Échanges avec toutes les parties prenantes des projets : DevOps, QA, BA, …

• Réalisation des études et analyses techniques  : bases de données, modules, …

• Développement du back-end de nos plateformes.

• Mise en place de tests et insertion dans nos pipelines CI/CD.

• Réalisations de documentations techniques.

• Aide à la montée en compétences de développeurs plus juniors

• Veille technologique et amélioration continue de l’existant.

Exemples de projets que tu pourrais rejoindre à ton arrivée :

• Equipe Vente : tu contribueras à développer la boutique MaaS de notre produit. C’est une nouvelle fonctionnalité qui a été lancée il y a quelques mois. Elle permet à un usager de consommer des billets combinant plusieurs modes de transport différents.

• Equipe IDFM pour le pass Navigo à Paris utilisé par des millions de franciliens au quotidien : tu participeras à l’amélioration et la maintenance des interconnexions de web services et le traitement/transmission des nombreuses données (avec les API de la SNCF par exemple).

Stack technique : Java 11 -> 21, Springboot 2.3 -> 3.2, JPA, Hibernate, Microservices, MapStruct, Lombok, OpenAPI, MySQL, Redis, Sonar, Git, Bitbucket, Maven, IntelliJ, Rabbit MQ, Kafka, architecture multi-tenant, ...

C’est un poste polyvalent où tu pourras être force de proposition. 

Quelles sont les conditions salariales / avantages ?

• Fourchette de salaire de 50-55K € 

• Contrat CDI Cadre

• RTT

• 2 jours de télétravail/semaine possible (à l'issu de la période d'essai) 

• Crèche d'entreprise

Profil recherché

As-tu le profil que nous recherchons ?

Un Bac+5 en informatique est conseillé mais ce n’est pas une obligation. Nous accordons plus d’importance à tes compétences et ta personnalité que tes formations.

Le profil idéal que nous cherchons a au minimum 10 ans d’expérience en développement Java Back-End. 
C’est un poste où tu seras immédiatement opérationnel !

Compétences obligatoires :

• Bonne maîtrise du langage Java et des frameworks associés (Springboot, Hibernate, …)

• Maîtrise des bases de données (idéalement MySQL et MongoDB) : modélisation, optimisation, … (mais sans être DBA)

• Maîtrise des architectures distribuées et microservices

• Maîtrise des pratiques d’intégration continue, avoir une culture DevOps et Cloud

• Maîtrise des tests unitaires et intégration

• Maîtrise des méthodologies agiles

Compétences optionnelles :

• Connaissances sur un des Cloud du marché (GCP, AWS ou Azure)

• Connaissances sur Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins

• Connaissances sur Kafka

Qualités attendues : leadership, autonomie, esprit d’équipe, force de proposition, communication, curiosité et humilité, ...

Quel est le process de recrutement ?

Tu auras un 1er échange téléphonique, puis 2 entretiens dans nos locaux ou en visio, avec un test technique à réaliser chez toi.
Si ton CV n’est pas complet, ce n’est pas grave car on privilégie l’échange direct avec toi. Ce que l’on attend de toi ce sont avant tout tes talents, ta passion et ton état d’esprit !

Instant System s'engage en faveur d'un recrutement inclusif, de la diversité et de l'égalité des chances. Tous nos postes sont ouverts, à compétences égales, aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Ne passe pas à côté et postule !

title: Application project manager (H/F)
location: Aix en Provence, Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France
description:
La société
Tu es passionné par l'innovation technologique et aspire à jouer un rôle central dans l'évolution des applications métier ? iWE Delivery, une branche spécialisée d'iWE dédiée à la création d'applications de gestion de processus métiers.
iWE est un éditeur de logiciels qui déploie des applications SaaS de gestion collaborative. Pour ce faire, nous avons construit notre plateforme low code (LCAP) qui permet de créer des applications de gestion en quelques semaines, en co-construction avec le client selon une méthodologie projet agile éprouvée.

Nos clients nous confient pour la plupart le soin de créer l’application visant à gérer leur cœur d’activité. Nous installons avec eux une relation de confiance long terme et sommes au cœur de leur dispositif stratégique.

La collaboration est au centre de la plateforme iWE : une application iWE n’est pas seulement un outil de gestion, performant et agile, mais également un espace collaboratif ouvert, en interne comme en externe, où chaque participant au processus accède à une interface qui lui est propre, partage des données ou documents en temps réel, est guidé pour réaliser des tâches, etc.

Nos premières solutions ont été déployées dans le secteur de l’assurance, secteur sur lequel l’expertise d’iWE est maintenant reconnue. Nous étendons aujourd’hui l’activité au secteur plus large de la prestation de services.

Vos missions :
Ton poste consiste à orchestrer la vie d'applications métier en production, tu devras :

• Être le référent fonctionnel du client sur son application : comprendre ses besoins, les challenger et les prioriser avec lui (comité de projet, backlog),

• Piloter les releases de bout en bout : spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques, sizing, planification, recette, mise en production,

• Mettre les mains dans la configuration : diagnostiquer les anomalies dans le paramétrage (YAML/JSON) et les données (MongoDB), et réaliser toi-même des évolutions en low-code,

• Être le chef d'orchestre de l'équipe (développeurs low-code, intégrateurs, QA, support) et garantir la qualité, les délais et les engagements de service,

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de l'application, du produit et des pratiques de l'équipe.

Environnement technique d’iWE :

• Low-code iWE,

• Visual code (Yaml, Json, JS), 

• Base de donnée : MongoDB,

• Gitlab, github, 

• IA intégrée au quotidien : Claude Code et agents IA pour accélérer l'analyse, la configuration et la rédaction des spécifications, 

• MY : outil interne de gestion des demandes et des releases.

Profil recherché
Profil recherché :
• De formation BAC+5, tu justifies d'une expérience réussie (3 ans minimum) en gestion de projet applicatif, en consulting fonctionnel avec une forte dimension technique, ou en développement applicatif avec une appétence client,

• Profil techno-fonctionnel : tu es autant à l'aise en atelier avec un client qu'en train de lire une configuration YAML ou de requêter une base MongoDB pour comprendre un comportement,

• Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de reformulation, qui te permettent de traduire un besoin métier en spécification exploitable par une équipe technique,

• Tu sais lire et modifier des fichiers de configuration (YAML, JSON) ; des notions de JavaScript sont un plus,

• Tu as des bases en requêtage MongoDB ; la gestion de code source avec Git serait un plus,

• Tu as des notions solides en modélisation des données et, idéalement, en modélisation de processus (BPMN),

• Tu sais animer une réunion client, tenir un planning et dire non avec le sourire quand il le faut,

• Tu es curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se) et apprécies le travail en équipe.

Rejoindre iWE c'est : 
• Travailler dans une entreprise à taille humaine (30 collaborateurs) ou l'innovation, les perspectives d'évolutions et les afterworks sont nombreux,

• Le respect de l'équilibre vie pro / vie perso grâce à la flexibilité des horaires et jusqu'à 2 jours de TT/semaine,

• Un package financier attractif (Salaire compétitif, tickets restaurant, RTT..)

title: Assistant Commercial Banque Directe H/F
description:
Rejoignez la Banque Directe du Crédit Agricole Alpes Provence en contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) !
En tant qu'Assistant commercial, vous assurerez l'accueil et l'orientation de l'ensemble des clients. Vous contribuez à l'atteinte des objectifs commerciaux de son agence par l'exploitation des opportunités commerciales en rebond commercial afin d’être dans le référentiel de son métier. Vous réalisez des opérations de gestion administrative des clients dans le respect des règles de conformité. Vous prenez en charge les réclamations et le SAV.

Votre quotidien, dans la joie et la bonne humeur, sera :
• Accueillir le client en mode multi canal (téléphone, mail)

• Effectuer les opérations du quotidien pour les clients : virements, déplafonnements cartes bancaires, mises à disposition de fonds et gérer l'envoi des moyens de paiements…etc

• Faire vivre les relations transversales, échanger les bonnes pratiques avec les autres conseillers et l'ensemble de l'agence.

• Être porteur des valeurs mutualistes et de l'image de l'entreprise.

• Adhérer au projet d'entreprise et s'impliquer.

• Effectuer les opérations du quotidien pour les clients

• Assurer le service après-vente

• Traiter les opérations dans le respect de la conformité et des risques.

• Fiabiliser et enrichir les données de connaissance client (tél, mail).

• Accueillir le client en mode multi canal

• Prendre en charge les appels entrants (taux de décroché 95%) et mail client (réponse immédiate ou prise de rdv conseiller)

• Veiller au respect des engagements clients et maintenir une très haute qualité de service.

• Utiliser et faire la promotion de tous les canaux de la Caisse (Internet, LSB, CCM, Ma Banque).

• Traiter les opérations du périmètre avec fiabilité et rigueur.

• Contribuer à ne perdre aucun client pour insatisfaction

• Traiter les réclamations et orienter les clients dès le signal d'insatisfaction

Et si c’était vous ?
Vous êtes dynamique, rigoureux et vous avez une forte appétence commerciale ?
Vous souhaitez relever des challenges commerciaux en équipe ?
Vous voulez exercer un métier au contact du client (100% à distance) ?
Pour vous, la qualité de la relation client est un atout majeur ?
Vous avez validé à minima un BAC + 2 ?
Vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins 1 an sur des métiers commerciaux & en contact client ?

Ce poste est fait pour vous !

Vous êtes convaincus ? Maintenant à nous de vous convaincre !

Laissez-nous vous donner quelques éléments afin que vous puissiez nous connaître un peu plus.

Acteur majeur dans le territoire, le Crédit Agricole Alpes Provence agit chaque jour dans votre intérêt et celui de la société. Il nous tient à cœur d'être proche, solidaire et de contribuer encore davantage au développement durable de notre territoire.

Et la rémunération et les avantages alors ? Parlons-en !
Nous vous proposons une rémunération adaptée à votre profil, composée d’un fixe et d’un variable. Rémunération annuelle brute entre 28 600 € et 36 000 €.

Intégrer le Crédit Agricole Alpes Provence, c’est aussi de nombreux avantages :

- Mutuelle entreprise
